Eres tan famoso y querido que incluso tus enemigos son fanáticos y se sorprenden al verte aquí. Elige una criatura objetivo que pueda verte para reconocerlo. El objetivo debe intentar una salvación de contra la CD de tu clase o la CD del conjuro, la que sea mayor. Independientemente del resultado, el objetivo se vuelve temporalmente inmune a Acknowledge Fan durante 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico El objetivo no se ve afectado y se vuelve temporalmente inmune a Reconocimiento del ventilador durante 1 día.

Éxito El objetivo queda Aturdido 1 y se vuelve temporalmente inmune a Acknowledge Fan durante 1 día.

Fallo El objetivo está Aturdido 2.

Fallo crítico El objetivo es hasta el final de tu próximo turno.

Especial Esta hazaña tiene el rasgo arcano u oculto, que coincide con la elección que hiciste cuando tomaste .

name: Dedicación de celebridades
desc: Cuanta más gente te mire, más contenido estarás y aprovechas cada oportunidad para mostrar a los demás cuando sus actuaciones no son perfectas.
fulldesc:
Cuanta más gente te mire, más contenido estarás y aprovechas cada oportunidad para mostrar a los demás cuando sus actuaciones no son perfectas.

Obtienes la reacción . Además, cuando haces , si el nivel de la tarea es superior a tu nivel, obtienes una bonificación de circunstancia +1 a tu prueba para obtener ingresos.

Celebridad

name: Atención de comando
desc: Llamas la atención de todos los que te rodean con estilo, asegurándote de que su mirada se centre solo en ti hasta el final de tu siguiente turno. Sie
fulldesc:
Llamas la atención de todos los que te rodean con estilo, asegurándote de que su mirada se centre solo en ti hasta el final de tu siguiente turno. Siempre que una criatura en un @Template[emanation|distance:30] a tu alrededor intenta una tirada de salvación contra un efecto visual diferente, obtiene un resultado un grado de éxito mejor que el obtenido. Este es un efecto fortuna.

Cuando un enemigo dentro del aura intenta utilizar un efecto visual que implica centrar su atención en una criatura en particular (como la Mirada de enfoque de una medusa), debe lograr una salvación de contra la CD de tu clase o la CD del conjuro, lo que sea mayor, para poder apuntar a cualquier criatura excepto a ti.

Los aliados en el aura pueden intentar incluso si no tienen cobertura, ya que continuamente estás proporcionando una distracción.

name: Elogio a regañadientes
desc: Desencadenante Un enemigo a 30 pies te daña o supera una prueba de habilidad.
fulldesc:
Desencadenante Un enemigo a 30 pies te daña o supera una prueba de habilidad.

Cada Firebrand puede reconocer la habilidad de los demás, pero tú la has convertido en un arte que puedes utilizar en combate. Felicitas la forma o técnica de un enemigo y tus elogios inesperados lo distraen de su entorno. Intenta una prueba contra la CD de Voluntad de ese enemigo. Independientemente de tu resultado, son temporalmente inmunes a tus elogios a regañadientes durante 10 minutos.

Éxito crítico El objetivo se convierte en durante 1 ronda.

Éxito El objetivo queda desprevenido ante tus ataques durante 1 ronda.

name: Mirada fascinante
desc: Cuando te encuentras con la mirada de alguien, esa persona no puede apartar la mirada de ti. Elige una criatura objetivo que puedas ver y que pueda ve
fulldesc: Cuando te encuentras con la mirada de alguien, esa persona no puede apartar la mirada de ti. Elige una criatura objetivo que puedas ver y que pueda verte a ti. Esa criatura debe tener éxito en una salvación o estar contigo hasta el final de tu siguiente turno; la DC es la DC más alta de tu clase o DC de conjuro. Si la criatura tiene éxito en su salvación o su fascinación termina debido a una acción hostil, se vuelve temporalmente inmune a tu Mirada fascinante durante 1 día.

name: Nunca te canses
desc: Desencadenante Obtendrías la condición .
fulldesc:
Desencadenante Obtendrías la condición .

Requisitos Estás por al menos tres criaturas que no son enemigas.

Mientras tengas una audiencia, puedes continuar actuando incluso cuando estés al borde del colapso. De hecho, debes hacerlo: ¡tienes una obligación con tus fans! Retrasas los efectos de la condición durante 1 minuto o hasta que ya no seas observado por al menos tres criaturas que no sean enemigas, lo que ocurra primero. Si la condición de fatiga tiene una duración, la duración comienza a transcurrir sólo después del retraso. No puedes retrasar ni prevenir más la condición de fatiga después de que finalice esta habilidad.

name: Primadonna
prereq: Dedicación de celebridades; maestría en performance
desc: Frecuencia una vez por hora
fulldesc:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

El foco de atención siempre debe estar puesto en ti y sólo en ti. Intenta una prueba contra las CD de Voluntad de todos los enemigos dentro de @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} que puedan verte u oírte. Si tienes éxito, los objetivos se centran en ti y obtienen un bono de circunstancia +1 para golpearte, pero son para todas las criaturas excepto tú. Con un éxito crítico, el efecto dura 3 rondas.

name: ¡Eres una vergüenza!
desc: Desencadenante Un aliado dentro de 30 pies falla una tirada de salvación de Voluntad contra un efecto de incapacitación.
fulldesc:
Desencadenante Un aliado dentro de 30 pies falla una tirada de salvación de Voluntad contra un efecto de incapacitación.

Algunos Firebrands no pueden soportar que sus aliados arruinen su momento, y tú no eres diferente. Tu fuerte y contundente condena de un aliado que sucumbe a un efecto de incapacitación le da una segunda oportunidad de impresionarte y librarse del efecto. Tu aliado vuelve a realizar la tirada de salvación de Voluntad desencadenante con un bono de circunstancia +1. Independientemente del resultado de la salvación, tu aliado es temporalmente inmune a ¡Eres una vergüenza! durante 10 minutos.

name: Devoción avanzada
desc: Obtienes una hazaña de campeón. Para cumplir con sus requisitos previos, tu nivel de campeón es igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.
fulldesc:
Obtienes una hazaña de campeón. Para cumplir con sus requisitos previos, tu nivel de campeón es igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.

Especial Puedes seleccionar esta hazaña más de una vez. Cada vez que lo seleccionas, obtienes otra hazaña de campeón.

name: Devoción básica
desc: Obtienes una dote de campeón de nivel 1 o 2.
fulldesc: Obtienes una dote de campeón de nivel 1 o 2.

name: Dedicación del campeón
desc: Elige una deidad. Estás sujeto al anatema de tu deidad y obtienes el aura y la santificación del campeón como se describe en la clase de campeón. Elig
fulldesc:
Elige una deidad. Estás sujeto al anatema de tu deidad y obtienes el aura y la santificación del campeón como se describe en la clase de campeón. Elige una causa como lo harías si fueras un campeón, con las mismas opciones que debe cumplir un campeón. Obtienes sus edictos y anatema, pero no obtienes las otras habilidades.

Te capacitas en Religión y en la habilidad asociada a tu deidad; Para cada una de estas habilidades en las que ya estabas capacitado, en cambio, te capacitarás en una habilidad de tu elección. Te entrenas en la clase de campeón DC. Si luego obtienes un conjuro de devoción, te capacitarás en el modificador de ataque de conjuros y la CD de conjuros.

Te entrenas en armadura ligera y armadura media. Si ya estabas entrenado en armadura ligera y armadura media, también obtendrás entrenamiento en armadura pesada. Siempre que obtienes un rasgo de clase que te otorga experto o mayor competencia en cualquier tipo de armadura (pero no en defensa sin armadura), también obtienes esa competencia en los tipos de armadura que te otorga esta dote. Si tienes un rasgo de clase que te otorga competencia experta en defensa sin armadura y eres de nivel 13 o superior, también te conviertes en un experto en los tipos de armadura que te otorga esta dote.

Campeón

name: Resiliencia del campeón
prereq: Dedicación del campeón; clase que no otorga más puntos de vida por nivel que 8 + tu modificador de Constitución
desc: Obtienes 3 puntos de vida adicionales por cada dote de clase de arquetipo de campeón que tengas. A medida que continúas seleccionando dotes de clase d
fulldesc: Obtienes 3 puntos de vida adicionales por cada dote de clase de arquetipo de campeón que tengas. A medida que continúas seleccionando dotes de clase de arquetipo de campeón, continúas ganando puntos de vida adicionales de esta manera.

name: La reacción del campeón
desc: Puedes utilizar la reacción del campeón asociada a tu causa.
fulldesc: Puedes utilizar la reacción del campeón asociada a tu causa.

name: Bendición devota
desc: Obtienes la bendición de la característica de clase dedicada, eligiendo entre las bendiciones enumeradas o cualquier otra a la que tengas acceso.
fulldesc: Obtienes la bendición de la característica de clase dedicada, eligiendo entre las bendiciones enumeradas o cualquier otra a la que tengas acceso.

name: Magia devota
desc: Obtienes un conjuro de devoción de tu elección que figura en el rasgo de clase Conjuros de devoción, siguiendo las mismas restricciones enumeradas all
fulldesc: Obtienes un conjuro de devoción de tu elección que figura en el rasgo de clase Conjuros de devoción, siguiendo las mismas restricciones enumeradas allí.

name: Tiempo de préstamo
desc: Frecuencia una vez por minuto
fulldesc:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Desencadenante Comienza tu turno.

Avanzas y aprovechas el tiempo que aún está por llegar. Te conviertes en y puedes usar la acción adicional para dar un paso, caminar o golpear. Obtienes esta acción adicional inmediatamente y puedes usarla este turno. Al final de tu turno, quedas Aturdido 1.

name: Dedicación al Chronoskimmer
desc: Te despegaste parcialmente del tiempo y aprendiste a manipular tu lugar en el flujo del tiempo. Cuando tiras iniciativa, puedes elegir una de tres opc
fulldesc:
Te despegaste parcialmente del tiempo y aprendiste a manipular tu lugar en el flujo del tiempo. Cuando tiras iniciativa, puedes elegir una de tres opciones: no hacer nada y tirar la iniciativa normalmente, estabilizar tu flujo temporal o desestabilizarlo y enviarlo a intensas fluctuaciones.

Estabiliza tu Timestream (fortuna) No tiras iniciativa, y en su lugar tu iniciativa es igual a 10 + el modificador que habrías usado para la iniciativa. Desestabiliza tu Timestream (fortuna) No tiras iniciativa, y en su lugar intentas un . Si tienes éxito, tu iniciativa es igual a 19 + el modificador que habrías usado para la iniciativa, y si fallas, tu iniciativa es igual a 1 + ese modificador. Además, si el resultado de tu tirada de iniciativa está empatado con la tirada de iniciativa de un oponente, tú vas primero.

Tu manipulación del tiempo te otorga acceso a una serie de habilidades, algunas de las cuales requieren una tirada de salvación. La CD para estas habilidades es la CD de tu clase o la CD del conjuro, la que sea mayor, y se llama CD de cronoskimmer.

Chronoskimmer

name: Premonición de combate
desc: Al reducir tu sentido del futuro, puedes mejorar el de tus aliados. Cuando tiras iniciativa, en lugar de estabilizar o desestabilizar tu propia corrie
fulldesc: Al reducir tu sentido del futuro, puedes mejorar el de tus aliados. Cuando tiras iniciativa, en lugar de estabilizar o desestabilizar tu propia corriente temporal, puedes otorgar a tus aliados un destello de información sobre su futuro. Elige dos aliados. Esos aliados hacen su tirada de iniciativa dos veces y obtienen el mejor resultado; Este es un efecto fortuna. Tiras tu tirada de iniciativa dos veces y obtienes el peor resultado; Este es un efecto de desgracia. Los dos efectos están relacionados: si evitas el efecto de desgracia por cualquier motivo, o si alguno de tus aliados niega su efecto de fortuna, tu Premonición de combate no hace nada.

name: Línea de tiempo de escape
desc: Frecuencia una vez al día
fulldesc:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante Comienza tu turno.

Sales momentáneamente del flujo del tiempo, lo que te permite evitar peligros. Tu forma física deja de existir momentáneamente y no puedes ser objetivo ni afectado hasta el comienzo de tu siguiente turno; simplemente no existes en ese momento. Tu turno termina inmediatamente, avanzando 1 ronda para todas las duraciones y efectos cronometrados, como condiciones y aflicciones. Aún intentas tiradas de salvación, pruebas fijas o cualquier otra prueba al final de tu turno de forma normal, pero no sufres ningún daño debido a estas pruebas (aunque sufres efectos no dañinos como de costumbre). Al comienzo de tu siguiente turno, vuelves a entrar en el flujo del tiempo y reapareces en el mismo espacio donde dejaste el tiempo la última ronda. Si el espacio no está despejado, llega al espacio abierto más cercano.

name: Guía la línea de tiempo
desc: Frecuencia una vez al día
fulldesc:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Sabes el resultado que deseas y mueves sutilmente la línea de tiempo hacia el destino previsto. Elige un aliado o un enemigo. Si eliges un aliado, la próxima vez dentro de la siguiente ronda que ese aliado haga una tirada de ataque o una prueba de habilidad, la tirará dos veces y obtendrá el resultado más alto; Este es un efecto fortuna. Si eliges un enemigo, la próxima vez dentro de la siguiente ronda que el enemigo haga una tirada de ataque o una prueba de habilidad, deberá tirar dos veces y obtener el resultado más bajo a menos que tenga éxito en una salvación de contra tu DC de cronoskimmer; Este es un efecto de desgracia. Independientemente de tu elección, el objetivo se vuelve temporalmente inmune durante 24 horas.

name: Restablecer el pasado
desc: Frecuencia una vez al día
fulldesc:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Manipulas el tiempo para recargar una de tus técnicas temporales, revisando tu pasado para que nunca lo hayas usado en primer lugar. Selecciona una de tus hazañas de cronoskimmer que tenga una frecuencia de una vez por día (o más frecuente) que ya hayas usado. Puedes usar la dote nuevamente, como si aún no la hubieras usado.

name: Carga inversa
desc: Te sumerges en la refriega antes de regresar a un lugar seguro. Avanza hasta tu velocidad. Si terminas tu movimiento dentro del alcance cuerpo a cuerp
fulldesc: Te sumerges en la refriega antes de regresar a un lugar seguro. Avanza hasta tu velocidad. Si terminas tu movimiento dentro del alcance cuerpo a cuerpo de al menos un enemigo, puedes realizar un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo contra ese enemigo. Luego te teletransportas de regreso al cuadrado desde donde comenzaste tu Carga Reversa. Puedes usar Carga inversa mientras excavas, trepas, vuelas o nadas en lugar de caminar si tienes el tipo de movimiento correspondiente.

name: Space-Time Shift
desc: Frequency once per 10 minutes
fulldesc:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger Your turn begins.

You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination. Your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Stride instead of traversing normally to the location. Your augmented Strides have the teleportation trait and don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square. You also augment your Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim actions in this way if you have the corresponding movement type.

name: Steal Time
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time. Select a creature within 30 feet. That creature attempts a saving throw against your chronoskimmer DC. The creature takes the effects of based on the result of its saving throw.

name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, these alternate selves flicker in and out in your vicinity, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your time duplicates is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the class feature.

name: Turn Back the Clock
desc: Frequency once per day
fulldesc:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again. You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus as you apply your experience from your last attempt. You must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.

name: Abscission Shards
desc: Requirements Your last action was a successful frenzied claw or spinning talon Strike.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your last action was a successful frenzied claw or spinning talon Strike.

You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target. The shard deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. This increases to 2d6 if your unarmed attacks deal three weapon damage dice, such as under a greater striking rune, and 3d6 if they deal four weapon damage dice.

name: Claw and Talon Flow
desc: Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).

name: Claw Snag
desc: Trigger A creature attempts to while you have them or .
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature attempts to while you have them or .

You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh. Shift into claw stance if you aren't in it already, then make a frenzied claw Strike against the triggering creature.

name: Clawdancer Dedication
prereq: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)
desc: You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you. You gain the following
fulldesc:
You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you. You gain the following two actions, which let you assume specific stances to strike more effectively with your claws.





Clawdancer

name: Dashing Pounce
desc: Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands. You , and if you end your movement adjacent to an enemy, you make two frenzied claw unarmed strikes against it. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. If both Strikes miss, you fall at the end of your Leap.

name: Feline Dance
desc: Access catfolk ancestry
fulldesc:
Access catfolk ancestry

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt a basic Reflex save.

Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging. Roll the save twice and take the higher result. If you were in claw stance, you shift to talon stance, and vice versa.

name: Hindquarter Kick
desc: Requirements You are in claw stance and have a creature.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have a creature.

You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides. Shift to talon stance and make two spinning talon Strikes against the grabbed creature. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. You then release the grabbed creature.

name: Hunting Snag
desc: Trigger A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close. Make a claw or talon unarmed Strike on the triggering creature. If it's a critical hit and the trigger is a move action, disrupt that action. If it hits and the creature left a square adjacent to you, you can Step into that square.

name: Precise Hooks
desc: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon. When you critically hit a target with your claw or talon, you can apply a critical specialization effect base
fulldesc: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon. When you critically hit a target with your claw or talon, you can apply a critical specialization effect based on the stance you're in. For claw stance, apply the knife weapon group's effect. For talon stance, apply the axe group's effect. These effects are in addition to the claw's or talon's normal critical specialization effect if you apply it.

name: Spinning Stand
desc: Requirements You're .
fulldesc:
Requirements You're .

You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position. You enter talon stance if you weren't in it already, make a spinning talon Strike against an enemy in reach, and then Stand. You don't take the -2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions. You can spend two actions using Spinning Stand to make two spinning talon Strikes instead of one; these Strikes must be against separate targets.

name: Springboard
desc: Requirements Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your previous action was a successful spinning talon Strike against an adjacent foe.

You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent. You , which doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy you struck. If you land within melee reach of an enemy, you can choose to make a spinning talon Strike against them.

name: Storm of Claws
desc: Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork. Strike three times, with your multiple attack penalty increasing as normal. After each attack that hits and deals damage, you can Step.

name: Talon Sweep
desc: Trigger A creature attempts to Strike you while it's flanking you.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature attempts to Strike you while it's flanking you.

Your long clawed legs let you catch enemies to either side. You shift to talon stance if you weren't in it already. If the Strike misses, you can make a spinning talon Strike against any creature flanking you.

name: Tear Tendons
desc: Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength. Make two frenzied claw attacks against the same target, increasing the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, the target must succeed at a save against your class DC or be Enfeebled 2 for 1 round; if it critically fails, it's instead enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

name: Wheeling Grab
desc: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes. You shift into claw stance and . If you moved through an enemy's space, you can it.
fulldesc: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes. You shift into claw stance and . If you moved through an enemy's space, you can it.

name: Advanced Dogma
desc: You gain one cleric feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your cleric level is equal to half your character level.
fulldesc:
You gain one cleric feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your cleric level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another cleric feat.

name: Basic Cleric Spellcasting
desc: You gain the Basic Spellcasting Feat benefits. You can prepare your deity's spells in your spell slots of the appropriate rank from the cleric archety
fulldesc: You gain the Basic Spellcasting Feat benefits. You can prepare your deity's spells in your spell slots of the appropriate rank from the cleric archetype.

name: Basic Dogma
desc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level cleric feat.
fulldesc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level cleric feat.

name: Cleric Dedication
desc: You cast spells like a cleric. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the divine spell list or any othe
fulldesc:
You cast spells like a cleric. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the divine spell list or any other divine cantrips you have access to. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for cleric archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are divine cleric spells. Choose a deity as you would if you were a cleric. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification. You become trained in Religion and your deity's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of deity.

Cleric

name: Divine Breadth
desc: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day. Increase the spell slots you gain from cleric archetype feats by 1 f
fulldesc: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day. Increase the spell slots you gain from cleric archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest cleric spell slots.

name: Expert Cleric Spellcasting
prereq: Basic Cleric Spellcasting; master in Religion
desc: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Feat benefits.
fulldesc: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Feat benefits.

name: Master Cleric Spellcasting
prereq: Expert Cleric Spellcasting; legendary in Religion
desc: You gain the Master Spellcasting Feat benefits.
fulldesc: You gain the Master Spellcasting Feat benefits.

name: Advanced Reanimated Companion
desc: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives. It becomes an adva
fulldesc: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives. It becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Minion action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.

name: Clockwork Reanimator Dedication
desc: You can animate corpses through cunning engineering. You gain a prototype construct companion to serve as a minion. Unlike normal construct companions
fulldesc:
You can animate corpses through cunning engineering. You gain a prototype construct companion to serve as a minion. Unlike normal construct companions, yours is a corpse animated by clockwork gears and technological prowess.

Special If you retrain out of this feat, you lose the rituals learned from it.

Clockwork Reanimator

name: Hijack Undead
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

Your clockwork devices can commandeer the bodies of undead, bending them to your will. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent undead creature. On a success, instead of taking damage, the target becomes by you if its level is equal to or lower than your level - 3. It can attempt a saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC to resist being controlled by you. If the target is already under someone else's command, the controlling creature also rolls a saving throw, and the undead uses the better result.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The undead creature becomes a minion under your control for 1 minute. The control ends if you or an ally attacks the minion undead.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

name: Improved Hijack Undead
desc: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands. When you use Hijack Undead, if the undead fails its save, it becomes your minion
fulldesc: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands. When you use Hijack Undead, if the undead fails its save, it becomes your minion for 10 minutes. If it critically fails, it becomes your minion for 24 hours.

name: Incredible Reanimated Companion
desc: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its cap
fulldesc: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities. It becomes an incredible construct companion.

name: It's Alive!
desc: You've mastered the use of electrical energy to power your clockwork creations. Whenever your construct companion takes electricity damage, it gains t
fulldesc: You've mastered the use of electrical energy to power your clockwork creations. Whenever your construct companion takes electricity damage, it gains temporary Hit Points equal to either half the electricity damage it took or your level, whichever is lower. These temporary Hit Points last for up to 1 minute.

name: Paragon Reanimated Companion
desc: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before. Your reanimated construct com
fulldesc: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before. Your reanimated construct companion becomes a paragon construct companion.

name: Self Destruct
desc: Trigger Your reanimated clockwork companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
fulldesc:
Trigger Your reanimated clockwork companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You're within 60 feet of your reanimated clockwork companion.

You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away. When you activate the device, your reanimated construct companion explodes, dealing 2d6 fire damage per level (@Damage[((2*@actor.level)d6)[fire]|options:area-damage]) to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30-foot radius}. Creatures caught in the blast can attempt a save, with a DC equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

name: Unwind Death
desc: Requirements The target's body must be mostly intact.
fulldesc:
Requirements The target's body must be mostly intact.

Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death. Attempt a check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of , except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or wounded 1 if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is then temporarily immune to Unwind Death for 1 day.

name: Zombie Horde
desc: You built your reanimated construct companion of modular components from various corpses. Its unique makeup enables your companion to split into dozen
fulldesc:
You built your reanimated construct companion of modular components from various corpses. Its unique makeup enables your companion to split into dozens or even hundreds of much smaller corpse constructs. Acting as one, this shambling swarm can overwhelm your enemies.

You Command your reanimated construct companion. Instead of its normal actions, the companion splits into a horde of Small and Tiny construct companions within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] from its original space. The horde makes a Strike against each foe within the emanation with a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack rolls. The multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the companion makes all the attacks. The miniature companions recombine into a single companion of their original size at any location within the emanation.

name: Advanced Field Training
desc: You gain a commander feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your commander level is equal to half your character level.
fulldesc:
You gain a commander feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your commander level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another commander feat.

name: Basic Field Training
desc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.
fulldesc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.

name: Commander Dedication
desc: You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choo
fulldesc:
You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing. You can prepare one of these tactics whenever a commander would be able to prepare tactics. You gain a commander's banner that grants you a 30-foot aura for the purposes of using your tactics, but the banner does not grant the commander's banner bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. You become trained in commander class DC and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

Commander

fulldesc: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore. If you're already an expert in Warfare Lore, you instead become an expert in another Lore skill you're trained in or trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

name: Officer's Mastery
desc: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore. If you're already a master in Warfare Lore, you i
fulldesc: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore. If you're already a master in Warfare Lore, you instead become a master in another Lore skill you're an expert in, an expert in another Lore skill you're trained in, or trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

name: Tactical Excellence
desc: You add two new mobility or offensive tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.
fulldesc:
You add two new mobility or offensive tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 8th level; when you do, you may choose your new tactics from either mobility or offensive tactics you do not already know or from any of the expert tactics you have access to.

name: Command Corpse
prereq: ability to cast harm; Corpse Tender Dedication
desc: You gain the feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of spells you cast on mindless undead. These spells can control creatures with a l
fulldesc: You gain the feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of spells you cast on mindless undead. These spells can control creatures with a level equal to or lower than your level -1 (instead of your level - 3).

name: Corpse Tender Dedication
desc: You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to on mi
fulldesc:
You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to on mindless undead and to make very simple Requests of them; their mindless trait doesn't grant immunity to these mental effects. Most mindless undead are likely hostile toward you by default and must be kept at a safe distance to give you time to Make an Impression.

You become trained in Diplomacy; if already trained, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

Corpse Tender

name: Corpse Tender's Font
desc: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead. You can cast as a divine innate spell once per day. This spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up
fulldesc: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead. You can cast as a divine innate spell once per day. This spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up. You can target only mindless undead with this spell.

name: Imbue Mindlessness
desc: You grasp the mind of an undead creature and temporarily wipe it as empty as a zombie's brain. You can target any undead with your divine innate spell
fulldesc:
You grasp the mind of an undead creature and temporarily wipe it as empty as a zombie's brain. You can target any undead with your divine innate spell, not just mindless undead. When you target one non-mindless undead creature with this spell, you can transform its effects. Instead of harm's normal effects, the target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is Stupefied 2 for 1 minute. While it is stupefied, you can use your Corpse Tender feats on the target as though it were mindless.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is Stupefied 3 for 10 minutes.

name: Improved Command Corpse
desc: When you use on a mindless undead, if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round. If the undea
fulldesc: When you use on a mindless undead, if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round. If the undead fails its save, it becomes your minion for 1 hour. If it critically fails, it becomes your minion for 24 hours.

name: Armor Rune Shifter
desc: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion. Once per day when you make your daily prepara
fulldesc: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion. Once per day when you make your daily preparations, you can focus on a rune's magical energies through a crystal's facets to alter a single property rune on one suit of armor in your possession to suppress its normal effects and make it function as a different property rune. You can temporarily alter the rune to function as one of the following runes: , , , , , . The property rune remains altered until you make your next daily preparations. The armor must meet the prerequisites for the temporary rune, and any other runes that required the suppressed rune are also suppressed while the rune is transformed. The rune is obviously altered, and thus the armor can't be sold as though it had the temporary rune.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

name: Crystal Keeper Dedication
prereq: trained in Elven Lore or Society
desc: You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing. When you Decipher Writing an
fulldesc:
You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing. When you Decipher Writing and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and when you Decipher Writing and roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

Additionally, you gain resistance 10 to damage from hazards associated with crystals.

Crystal Keeper
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

name: Crystal Ward Spells
desc: Your study of crystals and the energies held within a gem's facets grants you special arcane crystal ward spells, which are a type of focus spell. It
fulldesc:
Your study of crystals and the energies held within a gem's facets grants you special arcane crystal ward spells, which are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool when you make your next daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to research and memorize the properties of gems.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up. Certain feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points. You gain the focus spell, and you are trained in arcane spell attack rolls and spell DCs. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

name: Simple Crystal Magic
desc: As long as you meditate before a gemstone worth at least 10 gp as part of your daily preparations, you are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes th
fulldesc: As long as you meditate before a gemstone worth at least 10 gp as part of your daily preparations, you are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes that reveal information about magic objects, and you can scribe a personal rune that represents you. You gain the and cantrips. You cast these cantrips as arcane innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

name: Weapon-Rune Shifter
desc: You learn how to alter the magic of weapon runes by using a crystal as a focusing component. Once per day during your daily preparations, you can focu
fulldesc: You learn how to alter the magic of weapon runes by using a crystal as a focusing component. Once per day during your daily preparations, you can focus on a rune's magical energies through a crystal's facets to alter a single property rune on one weapon in your possession to suppress its normal effects and make it function as a different property rune. You can temporarily alter the rune to function as one of the following runes: , , , , , , , , or . The property rune remains altered until you make your next daily preparations. The weapon must meet the prerequisites for the temporary rune, and any other runes that required the suppressed rune are also suppressed while the rune is transformed. The rune is obviously altered, and thus the weapon can't be sold as though it had the temporary rune.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

name: Cultivator Dedication
desc: Through an esoteric, often exacting, regimen of meditation, diet, and exercise, you've learned to transform your body's inner workings into a crucible
fulldesc:
Through an esoteric, often exacting, regimen of meditation, diet, and exercise, you've learned to transform your body's inner workings into a crucible of planar and spiritual energies. These austerities allow you to refine your body's vitality into qi, the foundation of all cultivation.

You become an expert in Occultism. In addition, you gain the domain spell as a focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity meditating to refine essence into qi, which circulates and refills your focus pool. Your cultivator focus spells are occult spells. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

Cultivator focus spells are treated as qi spells for prerequisites, counting the number of qi spells you possess and their effects, such as a jiang-shi's Drain Qi.

Cultivator
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Cultivator's Keen Eye
desc: Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You can also sense the presence of precious mater
fulldesc:
Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You can also sense the presence of precious materials in the same range, which cultivators refer to as "cultivation materials."

When you participate in rituals, you can substitute all or part of the ritual's cost with an equivalent value of precious materials. This applies only to costs in valuable substances like diamonds, not to rituals that require specific items to function; the GM makes the call if it's unclear.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Ghost-Path Epiphany
desc: Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the
fulldesc:
Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators. You become sanctified with the unholy trait. You also learn the and rituals, which can be used to contact only undead or entities from the Void or the Netherworld.

When you cast a ritual, you can reduce the number of secondary casters by 1 as you direct decaying fragments of your own soul, felled by your proximity to death, to assist with the ritual. When you do, you must fulfill any requirements for the secondary caster, and you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that secondary caster. You can't replace a secondary caster who's the target of the spell (as in the atone ritual).
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Immortal Lightness
desc: You breathe, allowing your golden core to release qi into the meridians governing your lower body, and break into a burst of speed that could shame ar
fulldesc: You breathe, allowing your golden core to release qi into the meridians governing your lower body, and break into a burst of speed that could shame arrows in flight. You gain the domain spell as a focus spell.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Lotus Above the Wind
desc: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world's muck and mire. When you cast your or focus spells, you ignore dif
fulldesc: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world's muck and mire. When you cast your or focus spells, you ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: The Bitter Scholar's Promotion
desc: Tian Xia's shining cities belie its empires' long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice. You pursue immortality n
fulldesc:
Tian Xia's shining cities belie its empires' long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice. You pursue immortality not through tuft-hunting with Heaven's dragons or their imperial brats; yours is the power to crack its corrupt wheel, for you can now release the ghost gates to expedite the dead's revenge at being cheated of their fates.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as an undead to effects that can detect undead (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn rituals for , Jiang-shi, and . On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: The Immortal Attains the Summit
desc: Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven's will. Returning from your vision of the Holy Mountain, you become an immortal with mystic
fulldesc:
Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven's will. Returning from your vision of the Holy Mountain, you become an immortal with mystic potency over the terrestrial realms of wind and water.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as a living being to effects that can detect living creatures (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn the and rituals. You can use Occultism instead of Nature for these rituals. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Three Clear Breaths
desc: Through your disciplined condensations and circulations of qi, you've caught a fleeting glimpse of cultivation's promise, and your health has handsome
fulldesc: Through your disciplined condensations and circulations of qi, you've caught a fleeting glimpse of cultivation's promise, and your health has handsomely profited along the way. You gain the , , and feats. You must meet the prerequisites for these feats as normal. For each of these feats you already have, you can instead gain a different feat from the following list: , , and .
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Three Pecks of Dew
desc: At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh. While still fettered to the physical realm, your form flourishes without needing c
fulldesc:
At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh. While still fettered to the physical realm, your form flourishes without needing conventional food or drink, and your natural healing now rivals that brought by scalpel and suture.

You become sanctified with the holy trait. When you perform the Subsist downtime activity, you can use Occultism for the skill check (instead of the skills normally associated with your environment). If you do so, this activity gains the vitality trait as you subsist on ambient qi within your environment's dew-laden air and create shelter from solidified emanations of qi.

Additionally, when you Refocus, you can also at the same time. If you do so, you can use Occultism for checks to Treat Wounds and disregard the need for a ; this activity gains the vitality trait as you circulate healing qi through your own body or transfuse your ally with healing qi.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Wisteria-and-Peony Reunion
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You Cast a focus spell.

Your roots of qi stand firm, shaking off pains and aches like the returning flowers and leaves shed during winter's snow. You @Damage[(@actor.level + @actor.system.resources.focus.max)[healing,vitality]]{regain Hit Points} equal to your level plus the maximum number of Focus Points in your focus pool.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Accursed Magic
desc: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease. You can cast . At 10th level, you can also c
fulldesc: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease. You can cast . At 10th level, you can also cast , and at 12th level, you can also cast . You can cast these spells once per day as occult innate spells, but only while within your curse maelstrom state. If you couldn't already cast occult spells, these spells use Wisdom as your spellcasting attribute, and you become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics.

name: Counter Curse
desc: Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aw
fulldesc:
Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aware.

Requirements You're in a curse maelstrom state.

You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect, using half your level rounded up as your counteract rank and the higher of your class DC – 10 or spell DC – 10 as the counteract modifier. On a success, you neutralize the curse or misfortune effect. If the effect was constant, such as a misfortune aura, it returns automatically at the beginning of the creature or object's next turn. Whether you succeed or fail, your curse maelstrom state ends.

name: Curse Maelstrom Dedication
prereq: You are cursed or have previously been cursed.
desc: A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse's other effects have ended. You can
fulldesc:
A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse's other effects have ended. You can choose to suppress it, but if you instead let it manifest, you can channel its power in your favor. During an encounter, when you succeed at a check, the GM can offer to have you roll again, taking the second result. This is a misfortune effect. If you do so, you enter a curse maelstrom state. If the misfortune effect is somehow canceled or negated (by a fortune effect, for example), you don't enter a curse maelstrom state.



In addition, the curse is jealous of its place within your soul and gladly lashes out whenever others dare to usurp that position, granting you its power without the usual price. If a foe places a misfortune effect on your roll and the effect applies to your roll, you enter a curse maelstrom state, and if you fail a saving throw against a foe's curse effect and are affected by the curse, you also enter a curse maelstrom state. No matter the source, you can only enter a curse maelstrom state during an encounter, and if you don't end the state on your own, it ends at the end of the encounter. Once it ends, you can't enter a curse maelstrom state again for 1 minute.

While in a curse maelstrom state, you can't benefit from fortune effects, and they also don't cancel misfortune effects on you; they simply have no effect. While in this state, all creatures other than you within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take a -1 status penalty to all saving throws and skill checks due to the storm of bad luck swirling out of your body. You gain the action, which you can use to focus the brunt of your curses onto an unlucky target.

Curse Maelstrom

name: Familiar Oddities
prereq: Curse Maelstrom Dedication; trained in Occultism or Curse Lore
desc: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you. You gain a +
fulldesc: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to on a cursed item or a spell that has the curse trait.

name: Reverse Curse
desc: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator. Whenever you succeed at the counteract check to , the creat
fulldesc: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator. Whenever you succeed at the counteract check to , the creature is affected by its own curse or misfortune effect, attempting a saving throw against its own DC if the effect allows a saving throw. In the case of a constant ability, such as a misfortune aura, the creature is affected only until the beginning of its next turn, when the ability reasserts itself.

name: Share Burden
desc: Trigger An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but you are an eligible target for the
fulldesc:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but you are an eligible target for the effect.

You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state. Instead of affecting your ally, the triggering curse or misfortune effect affects you.

name: Torrential Backlash
desc: Requirements You are in a curse maelstrom state.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are in a curse maelstrom state.

Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you. All creatures within your curse maelstrom emanation except you take @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[void]]{1d6 void damage for each level} you have, with a save. Your curse maelstrom state then ends.

name: Unnerving Expansion
desc: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom. The radius of the emanation of your curse maelstrom state inc
fulldesc: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom. The radius of the emanation of your curse maelstrom state increases by 5 feet until the end of your curse maelstrom state. The outpouring of the curse is unnerving. You attempt to a creature within the emanation of your curse maelstrom; you don't take penalties for not sharing a language with that creature.

name: Collapse Wall
desc: Trigger A creature moves into the bombs' splash area.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature moves into the bombs' splash area.

Requirements You're within 30 feet of an area where you rigged bombs on a wall, cliff face, or similar vertical surface with or .

You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature. If your bombs deal enough damage to reduce the wall's Hit Points below its Broken Threshold, the wall partially collapses on the creature. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to the damage dealt to the wall (basic Reflex save; the DC for this save is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). On a failure, they must spend an Interact action to dig themselves out of the collapse, and on a critical failure, they must spend 2 Interact actions to do so.

name: Controlled Blast
prereq: Demolitionist Dedication; Bomber's field discovery, Directional Bombs, or Expanded Splash
desc: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously. If you have the feats, you can us
fulldesc: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously. If you have the feats, you can use it with or , even though you didn't throw the bombs. If you have the Bomber's Field Discovery or feats, you can apply the additional splash damage to one of the bombs when you Set Explosives or use Demolition Charge, and you can apply the increased splash area from Expanded Splash to all the bombs.

fulldesc: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance... by detonating a bomb to produce a devastating explosion, of course! You Set Explosives on a door, window, container, or heavy gate. When the explosives detonate, you can attempt an Engineering Lore check to the target. If a bomb would add an item bonus to attack rolls, add that item bonus to your Engineering Lore check. Since you're blasting your way in, you can't avoid breaking the object or structure. If you roll a critical success, you get a success instead.
