Due to your eldritch connection with your horde, it uses your AC, saves, and other defensive statistics like skill DCs, but is immune to the , , and conditions. The horde has resistance equal to your level to physical damage, but weakness equal to your level to area and splash damage. You share an animating force, so any damage that would be dealt to the horde is dealt to you instead, though you take damage only once from any ability that includes both you and the horde in the area of effect (though you take the greater amount of damage).

Necrologist

name: Dismal Harvest
desc: Frequency once per round
fulldesc:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your last action was a Mobbing Assault made by your horde that reduced at least one living creature to 0 Hit Points.

The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. The temporary Hit Points you gain increase by 5 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

name: Grasping Corpses
desc: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde. A creature that is damaged by your horde's is until the be
fulldesc: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde. A creature that is damaged by your horde's is until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Shambling March
desc: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command. Increase the Speed of your horde by 10 feet.
fulldesc: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command. Increase the Speed of your horde by 10 feet.

name: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting
prereq: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting; master in Occultism
desc: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.
fulldesc: You gain the Expert Spellcasting Benefits.

name: Master Necromancer Spellcasting
prereq: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting; legendary in Occultism
desc: You gain the Master Spellcasting Benefits.
fulldesc: You gain the Master Spellcasting Benefits.

name: Necromancer Dedication
desc: You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can p
fulldesc:
You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your dirge. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for necromancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are occult necromancer spells. You become trained in Occultism; if you were already trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Once per turn you can use a single action to create a single thrall within 30 feet. This action has the concentrate, manipulate, necromancer, occult, and thrall traits. You can use the action as described in the thrall trait.

name: Basic Death Dealing
desc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.
fulldesc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.

name: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting
desc: You gain the Basic Spellcasting Benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the necromancer archetype, add two common spells of that
fulldesc: You gain the Basic Spellcasting Benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the necromancer archetype, add two common spells of that rank or lower to your dirge.

name: Necrotic Bomber
desc: You gain the grave spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by spending 10 minutes doing the necr
fulldesc: You gain the grave spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by spending 10 minutes doing the necromancer's Refocus options.

name: Thrall Charger
desc: You gain the grave cantrip, allowing you to more aggressively use your undead servants.
fulldesc: You gain the grave cantrip, allowing you to more aggressively use your undead servants.

name: Advanced Death Dealing
desc: You gain one necromancer feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your necromancer level is equal to half your character level.
fulldesc:
You gain one necromancer feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your necromancer level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another necromancer feat.

name: Inevitable Thralls
desc: You gain the necromancer's reaction, allowing you to create thralls from the corpses of your enemies.
fulldesc: You gain the necromancer's reaction, allowing you to create thralls from the corpses of your enemies.

name: Horselord's Bond
desc: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion. You and your horse gain
fulldesc: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion. You and your horse gain greater darkvision. In addition, when your horse succeeds at a save against effects that would cause the , , or condition, it gets a critical success instead.

name: Shadowpiercing Charge
desc: Requirements You're riding your horse and wielding a melee weapon.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're riding your horse and wielding a melee weapon.

You charge into the fray on horseback, and those that lurk in the shadows will feel your wrath. You Command an Animal to have your mount Stride up to double its Speed. You can make a melee Strike at up to two enemies that are within your reach at any point during your mount's movement. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.

Each Strike that hits a creature in dim light or darkness deals an additional 3d6 damage of the same type as the Strike. This additional damage increases to 4d6 at 15th level and to 5d6 at 18th level.

name: Defy Chains
desc: Trigger A fiend within 15 feet of you damages you with a Strike.
fulldesc:
Trigger A fiend within 15 feet of you damages you with a Strike.

You turn to face a fiend that attacked you, looking them squarely in the eyes (if it has them) and showing no fear. You increase the amount of damage you take by @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),5,4))d6], and deal @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),5,4))d6[spirit]] damage to the triggering fiend. The damage you take and deal increases to 5d6 at 18th level.

In addition, if the fiend has an aura and you're in it, you can attempt an check to counteract the aura's effect, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank. If you succeed, the effects of the aura are suppressed until the end of the triggering fiend's next turn.

name: Gallop Across Shadow
desc: Though your enemy wields shadow and darkness as weapons, they are no impediment to you when you ride your trusted horse. To that end, your mount can s
fulldesc: Though your enemy wields shadow and darkness as weapons, they are no impediment to you when you ride your trusted horse. To that end, your mount can step onto patches of darkness as if they were solid. When your horse moves through an area of darkness, it can treat empty spaces as solid ground. This allows your horse to move across gaps bridged by darkness or even into the air, ascending or descending at a maximum of a 45-degree angle. If your horse isn't on actual solid ground and the area your horse is in becomes dim light or brighter, your horse falls.

name: Nidalese Horselord Dedication
prereq: trained in Nature; horse animal companion
desc: Access You're from Nidal.
fulldesc:
Access You're from Nidal.

Thanks to the deep bond you share with your Nidalese horse, the two of you gain remarkable abilities. You both gain darkvision and a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with the darkness or shadow trait. Your horse's Speed also increases by 5 feet.

You gain the following edicts and anathema.

Edicts oppose the forces of the Umbral Court where possible, provide comfort to those who suffer in darkness

Anathema mistreat your horse, worship Zon-Kuthon or permanently ally with those who worship Zon-Kuthon

Special You can pledge yourself to the cause of the Nidalese horselords if you've already taken the feat, allowing you to take this dedication feat even if you haven't taken two additional cavalier feats.

Nidalese Horselord

name: Face Your Fears
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

A lifetime of facing Nidal's terrors has taught you to fight through fear. Although you aren't immune to it, you can subdue the emotion to such an extent that many believe it doesn't affect you. Reduce the value of your condition by 1. If this would reduce the value to 0, you are no longer frightened and gain a +1 circumstance bonus against fear effects for 1 minute.

name: Repel Darkness
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

Your stoicism and courage seem to drive off darkness and shadow. For 1 minute, you suppress magical darkness effects of a rank equal to or lower than half your level rounded up within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. This doesn't provide light, but merely restores the area to its natural illumination level. You can Dismiss this aura.

If your horse is at least a mature animal companion, you can use Repel Darkness to cause the aura to emanate from your horse instead of you, as long as your horse is within 100 feet.

name: Fear No Pain!
desc: Frequency once per day
fulldesc:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 30 feet fails a save against a mental effect.

You have learned to endure pain without complaint and are capable of steeling your allies with similar resolve. When you give them a shout of encouragement, the triggering ally can reroll their failed save with a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Swift Support
desc: Nidalese horses are known as some of the fastest across all Golarion, and your mount has trained to ride quickly into battle. When you command your ho
fulldesc: Nidalese horses are known as some of the fastest across all Golarion, and your mount has trained to ride quickly into battle. When you command your horse to take the Support action, it gains a +5-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed until the start of your next turn.

name: Dismounting Strike
desc: Requirements You are mounted on your horse, and your last action was to Command an Animal to order your horse to Stride at least once.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are mounted on your horse, and your last action was to Command an Animal to order your horse to Stride at least once.

You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon. You use the Mount action to dismount your horse but can move to any space within 10 feet of your mount, as long as your horse moved at least 15 feet. You then make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 14th level, increase this to two extra dice.

name: Swallow Pain
desc: You're capable of absorbing pain with less difficulty than others, and your bond with your horse helps it similarly ignore such suffering. You and you
fulldesc: You're capable of absorbing pain with less difficulty than others, and your bond with your horse helps it similarly ignore such suffering. You and your mount gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level.

name: Hook 'Em
desc: Requirements A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.
fulldesc:
Requirements A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.

The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface—and then swing up to twice your Speed. If you end your movement next to an enemy, attempt an Athletics check to that enemy, tying them up in your rope.

name: Pirate Dedication
desc: As a pirate, you sail the seas in search of enemy ships to plunder and great adventures to embark on. You gain the general feat for Sailing Lore or fo
fulldesc:
As a pirate, you sail the seas in search of enemy ships to plunder and great adventures to embark on. You gain the general feat for Sailing Lore or for a specific coastal city you have a connection to (such as Port Peril Lore). You ignore the effects of difficult terrain or uneven ground caused by unstable ground (such as the deck of a ship). Additionally, you gain the action.

Pirate

name: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
desc: Spend enough time in Hell Harbor, and you pick up the paranoia encouraged by Arronax Endymion. Maybe you served under him on the Tyrannous, escaped hi
fulldesc: Spend enough time in Hell Harbor, and you pick up the paranoia encouraged by Arronax Endymion. Maybe you served under him on the Tyrannous, escaped his executioners, or had a friend who wasn't so lucky; whatever the reason, you have some of his wariness. Unless you're a willing target, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saves against creatures you consider an ally and creatures who are undetected by you. If a creature you thought was an ally reveals itself as an enemy, you get the same bonus against them until the end of your next turn.

name: Broadside Buckos
desc: Shimali Manux trains every Salt Breaker to fight in the cramped quarters below deck, and you've learned how to use these techniques with your crew. Du
fulldesc: Shimali Manux trains every Salt Breaker to fight in the cramped quarters below deck, and you've learned how to use these techniques with your crew. During your daily preparations, you can name up to five crewmates you will be working with that day. If an enemy is within reach of you and at least two of your crewmates, that enemy is against you.

name: Inner Sea Privateer
prereq: Pirate Dedication; expert in Sailing Lore
desc: You make your living as a pirate, as well as a little extra by hiring out your services to Andoran, Cheliax, or Mbe'ke. You need to recognize which sh
fulldesc: You make your living as a pirate, as well as a little extra by hiring out your services to Andoran, Cheliax, or Mbe'ke. You need to recognize which ships are legitimate targets and which you need to play nice with. You can use [[/act recall-knowledge skill=sailing-lore]] to about creatures native to the High Seas and flags, ships, and sailors in the region. If a ship is using a false flag or other disguise to hide its true allegiances, the GM will roll a secret Sailing Lore check for you to recognize it, typically against a standard DC for the level of the ship's captain.

name: Into The Storm
desc: Many Shackles pirates use the Eye of Abendego to great effect, but none have more familiarity with the storm than the Master of the Gales, ruler of Dr
fulldesc: Many Shackles pirates use the Eye of Abendego to great effect, but none have more familiarity with the storm than the Master of the Gales, ruler of Drenchport and five-time winner of the Free Captains' Regatta. You've learned his crew's techniques for fighting in severe weather. You reduce circumstance penalties to ranged weapon attacks due to wind or precipitation by 2. You can also use weapons you're a master in with a –4 circumstance penalty (–2 if you're legendary) even if wind or precipitation would normally prevent it, such as the effects of .

name: Pirate Combat Training
desc: You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates. You gain either the or skill feat, even if you do not meet its prer
fulldesc:
You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates. You gain either the or skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites. You have familiarity with the following weapons: , , , and —for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these weapons as simple weapons. Your GM may add additional martial weapons to this list as appropriate for your world or region.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Pirate's Pet
desc: An animal has become your loyal ally, perhaps after you liberated it from another ship or found it on a remote island. You gain the general feat. Your
fulldesc:
An animal has become your loyal ally, perhaps after you liberated it from another ship or found it on a remote island. You gain the general feat. Your pet gains an additional pet ability, which you can choose from the standard pet abilities or the following familiar abilities: accompanist, damage avoidance, independent, partner in crime, speech, and valet.

In addition, you learn a common 1st- or 2nd-rank spell that targets your familiar, and can cast it once per day as a primal innate spell. You can instead learn phase familiar and can cast it once per hour as a primal innate spell; it's not a focus spell for you. When you cast the chosen spell, you target your pirate's pet instead of a familiar.

name: Rope Runner
prereq: trained in Acrobatics; trained in Athletics; Pirate Dedication
desc: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and simi
fulldesc: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and similar objects. Whenever you succeed at an Athletics check to Climb or an Acrobatics check to , you get a critical success instead. You aren't while Climbing or Balancing on a rope or similar object.

name: Sharkskin Grip
desc: You served on nephilim pirate Ila "Sharkskin" Clare's ship, the Scorched Shark, and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with
fulldesc: You served on nephilim pirate Ila "Sharkskin" Clare's ship, the Scorched Shark, and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with sharkskin. As long as you're wearing your clothing, you gain a +1 item bonus to unarmed attack rolls, Acrobatics checks, and Reflex saves and DCs to Escape, [[/act grab-an-edge]], or avoid falling . In addition, when you successfully [[/act grapple]] a creature, you deal slashing damage equal to your fist damage dice to that creature as you abrade their skin.

name: Walk the Plank
desc: You frighten a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank.
fulldesc:
You frighten a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank.

Attempt to an opponent. On a success, in addition to the normal effects, you can also force the target to Stride up to its Speed immediately. You choose the path the target takes, but you can't force it to move into an obviously harmful space (such as into hazardous terrain or a space where it would fall) unless your check was a critical success. As normal for forced movement, this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

The target then becomes temporarily immune to Walk the Plank for 10 minutes.

name: No Gods, Only Mortals!
desc: Frequency once per 10 minutes
fulldesc:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You successfully Recognize a Spell with the divine trait.

You order the caster to stop their spellcasting. Attempt an check to counteract the triggering spell, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank.

name: Traces of the Divine
desc: You can detect those who use divine magic like an additional sense. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and Surviva
fulldesc: You can detect those who use divine magic like an additional sense. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and Survival checks to [[/act track]] creatures that can cast divine spells. In addition, you automatically succeed at the flat check to target a creature that can cast divine spells, and the flat check to target a creature that can cast divine spells is reduced to DC 5.

name: Shake Off the Gods
desc: Requirements You're under an effect with the divine trait that required a saving throw.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're under an effect with the divine trait that required a saving throw.

Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god. You can attempt a new saving throw against the required effect with a +2 status bonus to the save. You can't get a worse result than your original saving throw.

name: Throttle the Divine
desc: You grasp the godly by their throats and damage their connection to their deities. When you have a creature , it must roll its flat check to use manip
fulldesc: You grasp the godly by their throats and damage their connection to their deities. When you have a creature , it must roll its flat check to use manipulate actions with the divine trait twice and take the worse result. Each time it attempts such an action while you have it grabbed, you tighten your grip further, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to @Damage[(2d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{2d6 + your Strength modifier} to that target.

name: Wrath Against the Divine
desc: You channel your commitment to removing the divine from the world as you recite the Laws of Mortality. Strike a foe that can cast divine spells. The S
fulldesc: You channel your commitment to removing the divine from the world as you recite the Laws of Mortality. Strike a foe that can cast divine spells. The Strike deals two extra weapon damage dice. The target must also attempt a save against your class DC. On a failure, it loses its highest-rank available divine spell prepared or its highest unused spell slot to cast a divine spell. If it has multiple spells at its highest rank available, it randomly selects which spell is lost. On a critical failure, it also can't cast divine spells until the start of your next turn.

name: Repelling Enforcer
desc: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine. Whenever you are dealt damage by a creature that can cast divine spells, that creature takes @Damage[
fulldesc: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine. Whenever you are dealt damage by a creature that can cast divine spells, that creature takes @Damage[5d6[spirit]] damage that ignores any resistance to spirit damage the creature has (but not immunity).

name: Mortal Possibility
desc: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness. Choose a skill you have master proficiency in
fulldesc: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness. Choose a skill you have master proficiency in. You become legendary in that skill. In addition, you gain a skill feat of your choice for that skill. The first time each day that you succeed at a skill check with that skill, you gain a +3 status bonus to your next skill check of any skill within the next hour.

name: Pure Legion Enforcer Dedication
desc: You are sworn to uphold the Laws of Mortality within the borders of Rahadoum. As part of your commissioning, you learned about the different types of
fulldesc:
You are sworn to uphold the Laws of Mortality within the borders of Rahadoum. As part of your commissioning, you learned about the different types of worship and divine magic that you might encounter. You become trained in Intimidation and Religion. If you are already trained in one or both of these skills, you become an expert in that skill. If you are already an expert in both skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the skill feat. Whenever you attempt to recognize a divine spell, you always learn it is divine and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the Religion skill check.

Finally, you gain the following edicts and anathema. Knowingly committing acts that violate the anathema result in you losing access to abilities granted by this archetype, as determined by your GM. You can regain these lost abilities by spending an appropriate amount of time rededicating yourself to the Pure Legion, typically by donating an amount equal to 20 gp × your level to appropriate causes and eschewing all divine magic (including spells cast by others) for at least 1 day.

Edicts confiscate, contain, or destroy all divine objects in Rahadoum; drive out divine casters from Rahadoum

Anathema use divine abilities, items, or spells; permit proselytizing of religion in Rahadoum; worship a deity

Pure Legion Enforcer

desc: You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an check against all enemies within
fulldesc:
You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC. Targets are then temporarily immune to your use of this ability for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target becomes Frightened 2. Until the start of your next turn, if the target attempts to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, it must succeed at a or the action is lost.

Success As critical success, but Frightened 1, and the DC of the is 5.

name: Unassailable Enforcer
desc: Your faith in the Pure Legion protects you from spiritual harm. You gain resistance to spirit damage equal to half your level. This resistance is doub
fulldesc: Your faith in the Pure Legion protects you from spiritual harm. You gain resistance to spirit damage equal to half your level. This resistance is doubled if the effect that caused the damage has the holy or unholy trait.

name: Holy Flower
desc: Milani's grace empowers you further. You gain the advanced domain spell from the domain you chose with Holy Bloom.
fulldesc:
Milani's grace empowers you further. You gain the advanced domain spell from the domain you chose with Holy Bloom.

Special If you selected twice, you can choose this feat a second time, gaining the advanced domain spell of the other domain.

name: Rise Up!
desc: Sometimes, you must even slip the chains of gravity to rebel. You shout a brief call to Milani, and you and two allies within 60 feet who can hear and
fulldesc: Sometimes, you must even slip the chains of gravity to rebel. You shout a brief call to Milani, and you and two allies within 60 feet who can hear and understand you can Stand as a free action without triggering reactions. All targets then gain a fly Speed equal to their Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater, for 1 minute.

name: Rose Warden Dedication
prereq: trained in Stealth; you worship Milani
desc: As a follower of the Everbloom, you stand up against tyranny and oppression, understanding that revolution against an unjust ruler must sometimes be e
fulldesc:
As a follower of the Everbloom, you stand up against tyranny and oppression, understanding that revolution against an unjust ruler must sometimes be enacted in secret. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception, you become an expert in your choice of Deception or Stealth. When you get a critical success to Lie to a figure of authority, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC and saving throws against being , , , , or by that figure of authority for 24 hours.

You add the edicts and anathema of to your own. Failing to uphold edicts or committing acts that violate the anathema result in you losing access to any abilities granted by this archetype, as determined by your GM. You can regain these lost abilities through the atone ritual as normal.



Rose Warden

desc: Requirements You witnessed an enemy harm an ally with a Strike or spell last round.
fulldesc:
Requirements You witnessed an enemy harm an ally with a Strike or spell last round.

When you see a foe hurt one of your allies, your righteous retribution causes your weapon to sprout holy thorns. Make a Strike against the triggering enemy. If you hit and deal damage, the target must also succeed at a saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become Enfeebled 1 (or Enfeebled 2 on a critical failure).

name: Holy Bloom
desc: Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you. You gain holy sanctification. Select the freedom or zeal domain. You
fulldesc:
Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you. You gain holy sanctification. Select the freedom or zeal domain. You gain the initial domain spell for that domain. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by praying to Milani or by working with others to plan a just uprising. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

Special You can choose this feat a second time, gaining the initial domain spell of the domain you didn't gain the first time.

name: Unbalancing Appearance
desc: Requirements A creature within your reach is to you, and you are by that creature.
fulldesc:
Requirements A creature within your reach is to you, and you are by that creature.

When you attack from the shadows, your foes are thrown off balance. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If your Strike hits, the target remains for the rest of your turn and is Clumsy 1 (Clumsy 2 on a critical hit) until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Unfettering Strike
desc: Requirements A creature within your reach has an ally or .
fulldesc:
Requirements A creature within your reach has an ally or .

With a damaging blow, you cause a foe to loosen their grip on an ally they're holding down. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If you hit and deal damage, your ally can attempt to Escape from being or as a free action. If your Strike is a critical hit, your ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attempt.

name: Liberated Mind
desc: Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.
fulldesc:
Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Your mind won't be held hostage by those who would seek to control you. You reroll the triggering save, taking the new result. If the effect would cause the or condition, you gain a +2 status bonus to the reroll.

name: Wall of Roses
desc: Roses are the symbol of Milani, and you can call forth a wall of them to stymie those who don't follow her teachings. You can cast once per day as a 4
fulldesc: Roses are the symbol of Milani, and you can call forth a wall of them to stymie those who don't follow her teachings. You can cast once per day as a 4th-rank divine innate spell. The wall is immune to fire and the piercing damage its thorns deal counts as silver for the purposes of resistances. Followers of Milani don't treat the wall's spaces as difficult terrain and don't take damage when they enter one of the wall's spaces.

name: Expanded Repertoire
desc: Your knowledge of runes grows. Add two runes of 5th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list a
fulldesc: Your knowledge of runes grows. Add two runes of 5th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

name: Runic Expertise
desc: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.
fulldesc: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.

name: Greater Expanded Repertoire
desc: You have gained extensive knowledge in the art of creating runes. Add two runes of 9th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from
fulldesc: You have gained extensive knowledge in the art of creating runes. Add two runes of 9th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

name: Runesmith Dedication
desc: You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the
fulldesc:
You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

You can etch runes. An etched rune is carved, inked, or branded; this application does not damage the creature or item. Etching a rune requires an artisan's toolkit. Your magic can sustain up to one etched rune at a time. If you're at least 9th level, increase the maximum number of etched runes you can sustain at a time to 2, and if you're at least 17th level, increase it to 3. You can etch any number of runes up to your maximum during your daily preparations or by spending 10 minutes in exploration mode. Your etched runes remain indefinitely until they're expended or removed or until you etch more runes than your maximum, which causes your oldest rune to fade. Additionally, you gain the action.

name: Basic Rune Magic
desc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level runesmith feat.
fulldesc: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level runesmith feat.

name: Advanced Rune Magic
desc: You gain a runesmith feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your runesmith level is equal to half your character level.
fulldesc:
You gain a runesmith feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your runesmith level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another runesmith feat.

name: Tracing Studies
desc: You can now create runes in the midst of combat. You gain the action.
fulldesc: You can now create runes in the midst of combat. You gain the action.

name: Stalwart Standard
desc: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent. Allies benefiting from your C
fulldesc: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent. Allies benefiting from your Cavalier's Banner feat also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to , , , and . Each benefited ally also gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against any creature that has dealt damage to an innocent of a lower level than that ally within the last round; summoned creatures, companions, or any creatures you or your allies put into danger on purpose to attempt to gain this bonus don't count.
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

name: Evasiveness
prereq: Rogue Dedication or Swashbuckler Dedication; expert in Reflex saves
desc: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.
fulldesc: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.

name: Operatic Adventurer
prereq: Acrobat, Celebrity, Dandy, or Gladiator Dedication
desc: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows. You become master in Performance, and at 15th level your skill in Performance inc
fulldesc: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows. You become master in Performance, and at 15th level your skill in Performance increases to Legendary. You also become expert in Theater Lore or become master in Theater Lore if you were already expert. When you're on a stage, in an arena, or otherwise at the focus of a crowd there to see you perform, your eagerness to begin grants a +3 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls if you roll Acrobatics, Intimidation, or Performance for initiative.

name: Perfect Pitch
desc: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic. You can use Performance to or spells and effects that are musical in nature. In add
fulldesc: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic. You can use Performance to or spells and effects that are musical in nature. In addition, you gain the action.

name: Costume Change
prereq: Acrobat, Celebrity, Dandy, or Gladiator Dedication; Quick Disguise; master in Deception
desc: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items. Yo
fulldesc: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items. You can remove any armor as a 3-action Interact activity. You can don light armor in 2 rounds, or in 1 minute for medium or heavy armor. You gain the activity.

name: Fit for the Role
desc: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you've mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visa
fulldesc: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you've mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visages. You gain the ability to cast as a 7th-rank innate occult spell once per day.

name: It's Not Over
desc: Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points
fulldesc:
Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points

Frequency once per day

In the world of drama, the finale of any performance doesn't have to be the end, and for you, this now extends to life itself. When damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you can use this reaction to suddenly spring back into action. Instead of gaining the dying condition and falling , you regain a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(10+@actor.level+@actor.system.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{10 + your level + your Constitution modifier}.

name: Tempo Shift
prereq: Acrobat or Gladiator Dedication; legendary in Acrobatics
desc: Trigger You Delay.
fulldesc:
Trigger You Delay.

Frequency once per hour

You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments. When you return to the initiative order after you Delay, you do so in an unpredictable way. All enemies are to you until the start of your next turn, and you become for the current round but can only use the extra action to Stride or Strike.

name: Fight Choreography
prereq: Acrobat or Gladiator Dedication; master in Theater Lore
desc: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to
fulldesc: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle. You can an ally's Acrobatics or Athletics check with a Theater Lore check. You gain the reaction.

name: Tragic Lament
prereq: Celebrity or Dandy; legendary in Performance
desc: Trigger A creature you're aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature you're aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker. The Strike deals normal damage rather than critical damage as your foe relents on their attack at the last moment as they're moved by your words, though other effects that happen on a critical hit still occur. The creature that made the triggering Strike must then succeed on a save against your Class DC or be Slowed 1 for 1 round by guilt at its actions against you.

name: More Real Than Real
prereq: Acrobat, Celebrity, Dandy, or Gladiator Dedication
desc: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond. Your ability to make people believe the stories you perform has t
fulldesc: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond. Your ability to make people believe the stories you perform has taken on supernatural power. You gain the ability to cast once per day as an occult innate spell.

name: Cutting Flattery
prereq: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication, trained in Intimidation
desc: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults. When you succeed at your
fulldesc: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults. When you succeed at your check to a creature, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, to a maximum of friendly, and they don't become unfriendly 1 day later.

name: Watch This!
desc: Trigger An ally misses or critically misses an enemy you can see with their attack.
fulldesc:
Trigger An ally misses or critically misses an enemy you can see with their attack.

A common saying among Firebrands is, "There's always a fool who thinks they can do it better—and they're often right." You verbally commit to using an action on your next turn to make a melee Strike against the same enemy your ally has missed. If your attack hits, you deal additional damage equal to twice the number of damage dice.

name: Skill Mastery
prereq: Rogue Dedication or Investigator Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
desc: Rogue: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a ski
fulldesc:
Rogue: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose; you must meet all its prerequisites.

Investigator: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose.

Special You can select this feat up to five times.

name: Promise of Pain
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Frequency once per minute
fulldesc:
Frequency once per minute

You call out to an enemy in distress, promising them a future of unending pain. Choose an enemy with the condition that you can see within 120 feet. That creature takes @Damage[max(10,(floor(@actor.level/2)*2))d4[mental]] damage with a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2d4.

name: Wrathful Presence
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Frequency once per 10 minutes
fulldesc:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You channel the unending wrath of the erinyes all around you. You have a 30-foot aura for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You and your allies in the aura gain a +3 status bonus to damage with Strikes. Your enemies who end their turn within the aura can't reduce their value below 1.

name: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Access You're from Isger or a member of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys.
fulldesc:
Access You're from Isger or a member of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys.

The fighting style of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys is rooted in their understanding of devils. You gain the general feat for Devil Lore. When you choose this feat, you can choose to become sanctified as unholy.

You gain access to the asp coil. You have familiarity with the and , treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency. If you're unholy, your Strikes using those weapons and your unarmed Strikes gain the unholy trait.

Special If you have the feat, the asp coil gains the monk trait for you.

Sister of the Golden Erinys

name: Eye for Weakness
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: When you successfully about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results. I
fulldesc: When you successfully about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results. If you critically succeed at the check to Recall Knowledge, that creature is to you until the end of your turn.

name: Golden Erinys Stance
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig
fulldesc:
Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh. In this stance, you can make fury's fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d6 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, backstabber, finesse, forceful, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

While in the stance, if you critically hit with a melee Strike that deals piercing damage, the target is Sickened 1 (with a DC to remove equal to your class DC); this is in addition to any critical specialization effect you might gain from the attack.

name: Fiendish Brand
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage. If it's successful and deals damage, you carve bleeding words in
fulldesc: Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage. If it's successful and deals damage, you carve bleeding words into your target. The target takes 1d6 bleed damage, which has the unholy trait. Anytime the creature casts a holy spell while this bleed damage persists, it must succeed at a or the spell is disrupted.

name: Vengeance Strike
prereq: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
desc: Trigger An enemy damages you and is within your reach.
fulldesc:
Trigger An enemy damages you and is within your reach.

You lash out at the foe who dared to attack you. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy. If you hit and deal damage, the enemy is to you until the end of your next turn.

name: Cruel Piercing
desc: You learn to impale your targets. When you're in Golden Erinys Stance, you gain the action.
fulldesc: You learn to impale your targets. When you're in Golden Erinys Stance, you gain the action.

name: Broad Snare
desc: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare so
fulldesc: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as broad snares. A broad snare takes up a @Template[type:line|distance:20] starting from the square in which you craft the snare but it costs two of your quick deployment snares. A broad snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.

name: Giant Snare
desc: You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.
fulldesc:
You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as giant snares. A giant snare takes up a 10-foot-by-10-foot area but costs two of your quick deployment snares. A giant snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.

name: Lightning Snares
desc: You can rig a trap with incredible speed. When you create a snare that normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it using a single Interact acti
fulldesc: You can rig a trap with incredible speed. When you create a snare that normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it using a single Interact action instead.

name: Plentiful Snares
desc: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients. Double the number of prepared snares granted by .
fulldesc: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients. Double the number of prepared snares granted by .

name: Domino Effect
desc: Trigger A creature triggers a magical snare you crafted.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature triggers a magical snare you crafted.

You've learned to pull the invisible strings of magic to affect targets that wouldn't normally be. A creature you choose within 15 feet of the triggering creature is affected by the same snare as if they had also triggered it.

name: Snarecrafter Dedication
desc: You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you. You gain the feat. When you set a
fulldesc:
You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you. You gain the feat. When you set a snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses the higher of your class DC or the snare's DC. If a snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare four snares from your formula book for quick deployment (increasing to six snares if you're a master in Crafting and eight if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When you increase your proficiency rank in Crafting to expert, master, or legendary, add three additional snare formulas to your formula book. The snares must be of your level or lower.

Special Rangers can adapt snare crafting techniques to create snares from natural materials. If you are a ranger, you can use Survival instead of Crafting for all prerequisites and functions of feats from this archetype. (This includes using Survival to Craft a snare.)

Snarecrafter

name: Brastlewark Snare Engineering
desc: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares. You learn the formul
fulldesc: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares. You learn the formulas for crafting the pit illusion snare and the shadow cloak snare or two uncommon magical snares of your level or lower that you have access to. When you set a magical snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses your spell DC if that's higher. When you craft a non-magical snare, you can choose to give it the magical trait. When you do so and the snare is one that normally deals damage, it deals an additional amount of force damage equal to its level.

name: Surprise Snare
desc: You install one of your snares prepared for quick deployment in a space that's occupied by an opponent. It must be a snare that normally takes 1 minut
fulldesc: You install one of your snares prepared for quick deployment in a space that's occupied by an opponent. It must be a snare that normally takes 1 minute or less to . The snare automatically triggers.

name: Barricade Snare
desc: Using clever gnomish engineering, you can quickly erect small barriers in which your snares are hidden. When you prepare snares for quick deployment,
fulldesc:
Using clever gnomish engineering, you can quickly erect small barriers in which your snares are hidden. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as barricade snares. A barricade snare consists of a small barricade in which the snare is hidden, but it costs two of your quick deployment snares. Though creatures can automatically see the barricade, the snare hidden inside the barricade must be detected like a standard snare, but with a +2 circumstance bonus to the DC. The barricade occupies the same space as the snare and is 5 feet high; it provides standard cover, can be Climbed with a successful check, has an AC of 10, Hardness 5, and 20 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The barricade lasts as long as the snare does. A creature triggers and is affected by the hidden snare when it attempts to Climb the barricade or successfully attacks the barricade while adjacent to it. The snare and barricade are destroyed when the snare is triggered or if the barricade is destroyed, whichever comes first.

Special Even if you have the Surprise Snare feat, you must craft a barricade snare in an empty square.

name: Remote Trigger
desc: You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly
fulldesc:
You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

You can Strike a snare to trigger it prematurely. If you crafted the snare, you automatically hit. If someone else crafted it, attempt a ranged Strike against the Crafting DC, triggering the snare only if you hit.

name: Remote Detonation (Snarecrafter)
desc: Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered. Choose a magical snare within
fulldesc:
Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered. Choose a magical snare within 120 feet that you crafted. The snare is automatically destroyed and each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[1d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage per level of the destroyed snare with a basic save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Special If you detonate a broad snare or giant snare, choose one square that snare occupies to be the center of the emanation.

name: Devastating Manifestation
desc: Requirements At least one of your soulforged armaments is not manifested.
fulldesc:
Requirements At least one of your soulforged armaments is not manifested.

Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them. You Manifest Soulforged Armament. If you manifested a weapon, make up to two Strikes with that weapon, each targeting a different creature and each dealing an additional 1d6 spirit damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn't increase until you have made all your attacks. If you Manifested an armor or shield, you gain resistance 5 to all damage until the start of your next turn. If you manifested both a weapon and an armor or shield, you gain both effects.

name: Soulforger Dedication
prereq: Wis +2 or ability to cast divine spells
desc: You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You bind a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as a soulforged armament.
fulldesc:
You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You bind a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as a soulforged armament. Choose a motivation or cause known as a soul path that ties you to your soulforged armament; acting against or ignoring your soul path is anathema to you and could lead you to be afflicted with a curse called soulforged corruption. Choose one essence power for the armament. Changing an essence power requires 1 week of retraining, and you can't retrain them while you have soulforged corruption.

You can to summon your soulforged armaments in combat.

Soulforger

ESSENCE POWERSYour soulforged armament has an essence power you choose when you first bind an armament. It gains this power temporarily when you manifest its essence form. Each power has a specific corruption flaw that affects you if you have soulforged corruption. Essence powers that apply only to some types of armament indicate which.

Adaptable Persona Armor only. When you manifest the essence form, gain your choice of a climb Speed or swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you're 8th level or higher, you can choose a fly Speed instead; Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

Bounding Spirit Melee weapon only. The weapon gains the thrown 30 feet trait and has the returning rune (even if it has its maximum number of property runes); Corruption Flaw When you make a Strike with a thrown or ranged weapon and miss, reroll the Strike targeting your ally nearest to the original target. This Strike uses the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

Deep-Seated Fear You gain a +2 status bonus to your Intimidation checks and don't take any penalties for not sharing a language when Demoralizing foes who can perceive your armament's essence form. When you Manifest the essence form, you can attempt to [[/act demoralize]] an enemy who can perceive the manifestation as part of the action; Corruption Flaw If you attempt to Demoralize an enemy, it also targets the closest ally to you.

Determined Toughness Any status penalties you take from the following conditions are 1 less severe than their condition value would indicate: clumsy, drained, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied. This doesn't change the actual condition value or any other effects of the condition (such as stupefied's disruption and its DC); Corruption Flaw Whenever you take a status penalty from the listed conditions, increase the condition's value by 1.

Harmful Malice (void) Your Strikes deal 1d4 additional void damage. You can cast harm once as an innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up; Corruption Flaw Reduce any damage you would deal by half your level.

Heroic Heart (mental) You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks; Corruption Flaw You take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls.

Healing Grace (healing, vitality) You gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can cast heal once as an innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up; Corruption Flaw Reduce any healing you would receive or grant with a spell by half your level.

Magical Resilience Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and AC against spells. If you're 5th level or higher, you can cast dispel magic once as an innate spell. The dispel magic is heightened to a rank equal to 1 lower than half your level rounded up (2nd rank if you're 5th or 6th level, 3rd rank if you're 7th or 8th level, and so on); Corruption Flaw You take a –1 status penalty to saving throws and AC against spells.

Planar Bond Armor or shield only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. You gain resistance equal to your level + 2 to damage of the selected type; Corruption Flaw You gain weakness 1 to all damage.

Planar Pain Weapon only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. Attacks with the weapon deal this type of damage instead of their physical damage, with a +2 status bonus to the damage; Corruption Flaw When you deal damage with a weapon or unarmed attack, you take @Damage[2[untyped]] damage of the last type you chose for planar pain. You take this damage even if it's of a damage type that normally wouldn't harm you, such as vitality damage if you are living.

Pull of Stasis Weapon only. Any time you hit with the soulforged weapon, the target takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. On a critical hit, the creature is for 1 round instead; Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

Reflecting Spirit Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks. If an enemy's physical ranged attack misses you, you can use your reaction to reflect the projectile back, dealing damage equal to half your shield's hardness to the attacker. The damage type of the reflected projectile is the same as type as the original projectile; Corruption Flaw You have weakness 5 to physical ranged attacks.

Resolute Defiance Shield only. The shield gains a +2 status bonus to its Hardness and temporary Hit Points equal to your level + 2 that last until the essence effect ends. If you don't have the Shield Block reaction, you gain it while your shield is manifested; Corruption Flaw When you take damage while you have a shield raised or use Shield Block, attempt a . If you fail, the shield is Dismissed if it's your soulforged armament or Dropped if it's a different shield.

name: Soul Flare
desc: Trigger An attack you made with a soulforged weapon misses a creature, or a creature hits you with an attack while you're either wearing manifested so
fulldesc:
Trigger An attack you made with a soulforged weapon misses a creature, or a creature hits you with an attack while you're either wearing manifested soulforged armor or have your soulforged shield raised.

Requirements Your soulforged armament is manifested.

You strive to change the outcome with sheer zeal. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll if making an attack or to your AC if you were hit. This can change the outcome of the roll. If this bonus turns your missed attack into a hit or the hit against you into a miss, attempt a . If you fail, your soulforged armament is Dismissed—your weapon if you attacked or your armor or shield if you were defending.

name: Rapid Manifestation
desc: Trigger You roll initiative or a hazard attacks you.
fulldesc:
Trigger You roll initiative or a hazard attacks you.

Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger. You Manifest your Soulforged Armament.

name: Soul Arsenal
desc: Choose an additional soulforged armament of a different type than you already chose, and choose one essence power for it. Upgrade or change your armam
fulldesc:
Choose an additional soulforged armament of a different type than you already chose, and choose one essence power for it. Upgrade or change your armaments individually.

When you Manifest Soulforged Armament, you can summon any number of your armaments (you must meet the requirements for each), and when you Dismiss the effect, you can choose to Dismiss some and not others. You can choose to manifest the essence form of any number of your armaments when you take the action. Each armament can manifest its essence form only once per day.

When you gain soulforged corruption, you choose one armament's corruption flaw to affect you for stage 1. At stage 2, you take the flaws of all your soulforged armaments. While you have the curse, each armament gets a separate flat check if you try to manifest its essence form, and failing the check prevents you from manifesting only that armament's essence form.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 12th level, choosing the final item type.

name: Redirect Spell
desc: You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another. You gain the Redirect Magic spellshift.
fulldesc:
You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another. You gain the Redirect Magic spellshift.

Spellshift—Redirect Magic Through sheer force of will, you can direct a spell's energies away from its caster's intended target.

Critical Success You change a single target of the spell to another viable target within 30 feet of you (even if it would be outside of the spell's normal range). You can't use this spellshift to affect a creature twice with the same spell. If the spell had an initial saving throw, the new target must attempt it, possibly achieving a different result than the original target of the spell. The DC for the spell becomes your Arcana DC instead of the original caster's spell DC.

Success As critical success, but if the target succeeds at any required saving throw, they are unaffected, and the spell does not change targets.

name: Spellshifter Dedication
desc: You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects. You accomplish this through the
fulldesc:
You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects. You accomplish this through the use of a spellshifting conduit, a magical object of your choice that has light Bulk and can be held in one hand. If your conduit is lost or destroyed, you can train yourself to use a new one by spending 10 minutes attuning yourself to it. You gain the action and the Share the Burden spellshift.

Spellshift—Shift Burden You share the burden of a spell, allowing you to share control with the caster. If Sustaining a spell with this spellshift causes a creature to attempt a saving throw, it is attempted against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, make the attack using your Arcana modifier instead of the spell's normal spell attack modifier.

Critical Success If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell. For the remainder of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell as though you were the caster.

Success If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell.

Spellshifter

name: Analyze Magic
desc: Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air. You gain the Analyze Magic spellshift.
fulldesc:
Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air. You gain the Analyze Magic spellshift.

Spellshift—Analyze Magic Once you've homed in on a spell or magical effect, you can study its unique magical signature to immediately understand exactly what it does.

Critical Success You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had critically succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

Success You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

name: Elemental Substitution
desc: You can tamper with the elemental energy of a spell. You gain the Elemental Substitution spellshift.
fulldesc:
You can tamper with the elemental energy of a spell. You gain the Elemental Substitution spellshift.

Spellshift—Elemental Substitution Raw elemental energy is the fuel powering some of the most iconic spells of destruction ever devised, and you've discovered a method for realigning the magical pathways through which that energy flows into the material world.

Critical Success If the targeted spell inflicts acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, you change its damage type to your choice of one of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. If the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type for 1 minute, then returns to normal.

Success As critical success, except if the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type until the beginning of your next turn, then returns to normal.

name: Subtle Shift
desc: You've learned how to hide your meddling from the casters of spells you're shifting. If your Arcana check when Shifting a Spell is greater than its ca
fulldesc: You've learned how to hide your meddling from the casters of spells you're shifting. If your Arcana check when Shifting a Spell is greater than its caster's Perception DC, you can prevent the caster from learning the effects of the shift you're attempting to apply. On a critical success, they don't become aware that you're applying a shift at all (although the effect of the shift might still give you away).

name: Dismantle Spell
desc: Your innate power can shut down other magic. You gain the Dismantle Spell spellshift.
fulldesc:
Your innate power can shut down other magic. You gain the Dismantle Spell spellshift.

Spellshift—Dismantle Spell You attempt to counteract a spell or at least suppress its effect for a time.

Critical Success The spell is counteracted if its rank is no more than 1 higher than half your level rounded up.

Success The effects of the spell are suppressed until the start of your next turn. If the spell has a duration that is measured in rounds, its duration is extended by 1 round. If the spell does not have a duration, it targets the same creature or area as though it had just been cast at the start of your next turn.

name: Reactive Spellshift
desc: Trigger A creature within 30 feet casts a spell.
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet casts a spell.

Requirements You are holding your conduit.

You can reflexively shift a spell even as it’s being cast. You attempt to Shift the triggering Spell even if you do not meet the other requirements to Shift Spell. On a success, the spellshift applies to the spell’s effects as appropriate for the chosen spellshift. After you choose your spellshift, but before you attempt your Arcana check, the caster can voluntarily let their spell be disrupted. Regardless of the outcome, the caster then becomes immune to your Reactive Spellshift for 10 minutes.

name: Enhance Spell
desc: You attune your senses to the magical frequencies generated by an allied spellcaster, allowing you to amplify or modify their spells to suit the needs
fulldesc: You attune your senses to the magical frequencies generated by an allied spellcaster, allowing you to amplify or modify their spells to suit the needs of the moment. Select one willing ally within 30 feet that you can see and choose one of the following spellshape feats: Conceal Spell, Nonlethal Spell, Reach Spell, or Widen Spell. The target gains the benefits of the feat on their next turn as though they had taken the spellshape action themselves; this requires them to Cast a Spell as their first action on their turn.

name: Gather Disciples
prereq: Starstone Aspirant Dedication; master in Religion
desc: Gods need followers, and you know that its best to gather a flock in the present to support you in your endeavor. Of course, you'll reward their faith
fulldesc:
Gods need followers, and you know that its best to gather a flock in the present to support you in your endeavor. Of course, you'll reward their faith in you in the future when you become a true deity. You can spend 1 week of downtime in a settlement to evangelize your coming godhood and establish a small group of disciples to your faith. Once this group has been established, these disciples are always helpful to you. You can use Religion to [[/act request skill=religion]] something of them, though your request must be able to be performed by the type of people who would follow you, at the GM's discretion. If you critically succeed at this check, your disciples give a piece of helpful advice or let you in on a small secret, granting you or a member of your party a +2 circumstance bonus to the first skill check you attempt when acting on the favor. If you critically fail this check, your disciples' attitude toward you doesn't worsen.

You can have three groups of disciples at any one time (or five if you're legendary in Religion). If you exceed this number, the oldest group disbands and must be established again if you return to that settlement.

name: Greater Deific Power
desc: Divine power continues to fill you. Choose two common divine spells, one of 4th rank and one of 5th rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine
fulldesc: Divine power continues to fill you. Choose two common divine spells, one of 4th rank and one of 5th rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.

name: Major Deific Power
desc: As your apotheosis into living godhood approaches, you accrue the strongest of divine power. Choose three common divine spells, one of 6th rank, one o
fulldesc: As your apotheosis into living godhood approaches, you accrue the strongest of divine power. Choose three common divine spells, one of 6th rank, one of 7th rank, and one of 8th rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.

name: Starstone Aspirant Dedication
desc: Divine glory awaits! You embrace your longing to make a true and lasting difference in the Universe by embarking on the path to apotheosis. You dedica
fulldesc:
Divine glory awaits! You embrace your longing to make a true and lasting difference in the Universe by embarking on the path to apotheosis. You dedicate yourself to this journey, striving to overcome all your imperfections. Each day during your daily preparations, choose a skill you're untrained in. You can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained in that skill, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks with that skill until your next daily preparations. At 8th level, this bonus increases to +2, and at 15th level, this bonus increases to +3.



Starstone Aspirant

name: For the Fallen!
desc: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed. Whether they were killed or disappeared, you vow to honor their
fulldesc: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed. Whether they were killed or disappeared, you vow to honor their memories by succeeding where they failed. This drive allows to push forward after you've already made an attack. You Step and then Strike.

name: Minor Deific Power
desc: Your mental, physical, and spiritual training have granted you access to divine magic that doesn't rely on any other deity or patron. Choose a common
fulldesc: Your mental, physical, and spiritual training have granted you access to divine magic that doesn't rely on any other deity or patron. Choose a common divine cantrip and one common 1st-rank divine spell. You can cast the cantrip as a divine innate spell at will and the 1st-rank spell as a divine innate spell once per day.

name: Norgorber's Secret
desc: Being the god of secrets, Norgorber has erased all traces of his life before his ascension so that his every mortal act and even his identity remain u
fulldesc: Being the god of secrets, Norgorber has erased all traces of his life before his ascension so that his every mortal act and even his identity remain unknown and unknowable. Something about this path intrigues you, and you've trained your own mind to defy intrusions. You gain mental resistance equal to half your level and a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that attempt to read your mind or discern your location.

name: Cayden's Freedom
desc: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean an
fulldesc: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean and his worshippers. After much physical practice, you've become difficult to restrain, and if you're ever grabbed, you can access a little bit of the Accidental God's luck. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC when resisting an opponent's attempts to you or Swallow you Whole. In addition, you gain the action.

name: Iomedae's Valor
desc: Frequency once per day
fulldesc:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Though you might not be walking the virtuous path of honor and justice most often associated with Iomedae, you have studied her mortal bravery and can emulate it when you're on the brink of defeat. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. You also gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute and a +1 status bonus to AC for 1 round.

name: Advanced Deific Power
desc: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets. Choose two common divine spells, one of 2nd rank and one of 3rd rank. You ca
fulldesc: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets. Choose two common divine spells, one of 2nd rank and one of 3rd rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.

name: Aroden's Innovation
desc: As befits the god of humanity and innovation, Aroden left teachings that continue to inspire. You've studied his works, and you understand the need to
fulldesc: As befits the god of humanity and innovation, Aroden left teachings that continue to inspire. You've studied his works, and you understand the need to constantly reinvent yourself to meet new challenges. Each day during your daily preparations, choose a general feat of 3rd level or lower. If you meet the feat's prerequisites, you gain the benefits of that feat until your next daily preparations.

name: Eye for Smugglers
desc: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to P
fulldesc: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden panels, secret doors or hatches, concealed objects, and similar items (at the GM's discretion). If you aren't using the action or Searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice these types of objects when you pass within 10 feet of them.

name: Liberty's Devotion
desc: You've deepened your connection with the ideals of Andoran. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with . Increase the number
fulldesc:
You've deepened your connection with the ideals of Andoran. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with . Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different advanced domain spell from a domain you selected with Liberty's Promise.

name: Perplex
desc: You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within
fulldesc:
You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within 30 feet that can hear you, and attempt a check against its Will DC. The creature is then immune to Perplex for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is Stupefied 3 and for 1 round.

Success The target is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.

name: Frightening Indignation
desc: Frequency once per day
fulldesc:
Frequency once per day

Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy. An enemy that ends its turn within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you must attempt a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This aura lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to your Frightening Indignation for 1 minute.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2 and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while it's in your aura.

Critical Failure As failure, but Frightened 3.

name: Steel Falcon Dedication
desc: Access You're invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People's Council.
fulldesc:
Access You're invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People's Council.

You serve as an envoy of the ideals of Andoran, whether it's in a foreign court or on the field of battle. Your training in the Steel Falcons enables you to anticipate the attitudes of others to achieve your goals. You gain the action.

Special You can take this dedication even if you haven't taken more than two non-dedication feats from the Eagle Knight archetype.

Steel Falcon

name: Denounce Tyranny
desc: Requirements You witnessed a creature harm an ally, harm a noncombatant, or commit a wantonly evil act in the last round.
fulldesc:
