Requirements You witnessed a creature harm an ally, harm a noncombatant, or commit a wantonly evil act in the last round.

You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it. Attempt a check and compare the result to the Will DCs of up to three of the triggering creature's allies within 30 feet of you. If you succeed on the check, the target refuses to treat the triggering creature as an ally for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical success). It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target. If you're a master in Diplomacy, you can instead target up to five creatures, and if you're legendary in Diplomacy, you can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Gray Corsair Training
prereq: Steel Falcon Dedication; trained in Intimidation
desc: You strike for Andoran on the waters of the Inner Sea and beyond. You gain the feat even if you haven't taken two other feats from the Steel Falcon ar
fulldesc: You strike for Andoran on the waters of the Inner Sea and beyond. You gain the feat even if you haven't taken two other feats from the Steel Falcon archetype or Eagle Knight archetype. You can select feats from the Pirate archetype as if they were Steel Falcon archetype feats.

name: Liberty's Promise
prereq: Steel Falcon Dedication; trained in Religion
desc: Your devotion to Andoran's ideals is as much spiritual as philosophical. You gain the cleric's feat but must select freedom, truth, or zeal as your do
fulldesc:
Your devotion to Andoran's ideals is as much spiritual as philosophical. You gain the cleric's feat but must select freedom, truth, or zeal as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a divine focus spell, and you Refocus by contemplating or spreading the ideas of the Common Rule rather than praying to a god. When an ability would manifest a divine symbol—such as the focus spell—it instead manifests as an eagle clutching a sword in its talons.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time.

name: Salt Kissed
desc: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning. You can cast and as 4th-rank divine innate spells once per d
fulldesc: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning. You can cast and as 4th-rank divine innate spells once per day each. Add the water domain to those that you can select with .

name: Uncanny Prediction
desc: Requirements You're benefiting from the bonuses of .
fulldesc:
Requirements You're benefiting from the bonuses of .

You have an eerie ability to guess the next move of creatures you've Sized Up. You inform a foe that you know exactly what it'll do next, momentarily shocking it into inaction. If your focus from Size Up is within 30 feet of you, your focus must succeed at a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be Stunned 1 (or Stunned 2 on a critical failure).

Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune to your Uncanny Prediction for 1 hour.

name: Hidden Intentions
prereq: Twilight Talon Dedication; master in Deception
desc: You layer meanings in your words, and only those you've taken into your confidence can divine your true plans. You gain the and skill feats. On the fi
fulldesc: You layer meanings in your words, and only those you've taken into your confidence can divine your true plans. You gain the and skill feats. On the first round of combat, if you roll Deception for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are to you.

name: Inked Cache
desc: You've learned to use your Twilight Talon's mark to secret away contraband. The tattoo's level increases to 10, unless it was already higher, and it g
fulldesc: You've learned to use your Twilight Talon's mark to secret away contraband. The tattoo's level increases to 10, unless it was already higher, and it gains the abilities of a . As a part of activating the tattoo to Store Item, you can attempt a check against the Perception DCs of all creatures that are currently observing you. On a success, a creature doesn't notice you use Store Item.

name: Feign Innocence
desc: You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side. Choose an enemy within 60 feet, and attempt a check against its Will DC. The ta
fulldesc:
You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side. Choose an enemy within 60 feet, and attempt a check against its Will DC. The target is then temporarily immune to Feign Innocence for 1 hour. If you've taken a hostile action against it this round, your result can be no better than a failure.

Critical Success You and the target are considered allies until the end of your next turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first. In order to take a hostile action against you, the target must succeed at a save against your Deception DC or it loses the action.

Success As critical success, but lasts until the end of your turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure The target knows you attempted to fool it and plays along. You're to the target until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Instant Credentials
desc: In a pinch, ink from your tattoo arranges itself into a temporary pass, writ of authority, or similar document. If you're in possession of a blank pag
fulldesc: In a pinch, ink from your tattoo arranges itself into a temporary pass, writ of authority, or similar document. If you're in possession of a blank page of paper, you can [[/act create-forgery traits=concentrate,occult]] as a single action with the concentrate and occult traits. The forgery lasts for 1 minute, and during this time, you can't use any of the other abilities of your Talon's Mark. You can Dismiss the forgery, leaving the paper blank once again.

name: Burn Identity
desc: Frequency once per week
fulldesc:
Frequency once per week

You transport yourself up to 1 mile, as a 5th-rank spell. Everyone who has seen you in the last 24 hours must succeed at a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or forget your physical appearance as though affected by a 6th-rank spell. You can choose to exempt any number of creatures from this effect. You can instead Burn Identity as an activity that takes 10 minutes. If you do, instead of the effects of translocate, you can instantly teleport yourself and up to four targets touched (either willing creatures or objects roughly the size of a creature) to the nearest border of Andoran, in addition to its other effects.

name: Twilight Talon Dedication
desc: Access You're invited by a current member of the Twilight Talons.
fulldesc:
Access You're invited by a current member of the Twilight Talons.

Few would even suspect that you're a member of the Eagle Knights, and you use the tricks of the spymaster's trade to keep it that way. You gain the general feat for Espionage Lore. If you were already trained in Espionage Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

During your daily preparations, you can brush up on a specific field to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat. If you have master proficiency in Espionage Lore, you gain expert proficiency in the chosen skill instead, and if you have legendary proficiency in Espionage Lore, you gain master proficiency in the skill.

Special You can take this dedication even if you haven't taken more than two non-dedication feats from the Eagle Knight archetype.

Twilight Talon

name: Make Do
desc: Requirements You're holding a broken tool or weapon.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're holding a broken tool or weapon.

You sometimes need to act in a pinch, even if you haven't had the time to repair your gear. For the next minute, you ignore the broken condition of the tool or weapon you're holding. You can't use Make Do again on that item for 24 hours.

name: Talon's Mark
desc: Requirements You have a magical or mundane tattoo.
fulldesc:
Requirements You have a magical or mundane tattoo.

On the rare occasions that Twilight Talons need to identify themselves as members of the organization, many rely on an easily concealed tattoo to reveal their allegiance. Choose a tattoo you have. If the tattoo wasn't already a magic item, it becomes a level 6 item with the invested, occult, and tattoo traits. It also gains the and abilities.

name: Fabricated Credentials
prereq: Twilight Talon Dedication; master in Deception
desc: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications. You can C
fulldesc: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications. You can Create a Forgery using [[/act create-forgery skill=deception]]{Deception}, rather than Society, and doing so only takes 10 minutes, or 1 minute if you're legendary in Deception. With your paranoid nature, you're always on the lookout for forgeries. The GM rolls a secret Perception or Society check for you any time you encounter a forgery, even if you don't examine it closely.

name: Deceptive Deduction
desc: Trigger A creature you can see uses .
fulldesc:
Trigger A creature you can see uses .

You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields. You learn what skill the creature was using to Recall Knowledge and whether that creature is trained in the skill. If it's trained, you can use Deception to Recall Knowledge as if it were that skill for the next minute.

name: Ship's Shadow
prereq: Undersea Privateer Dedication; expert in Stealth
desc: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself. When in the water within 20
fulldesc: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself. When in the water within 20 feet of a sea vehicle or climbing aboard one, you can move at your full Speed while Sneaking.

name: Propelled Leap
desc: Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air. Swim toward the surface at up to twice your swim Speed, then attempt a
fulldesc:
Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air. Swim toward the surface at up to twice your swim Speed, then attempt a check to propel yourself out of the water. If you do not swim at least 10 feet, you automatically fail. If your takes you near any structure or object and have at least one hand free, you can use the [[/act grab-an-edge]] reaction. If you do not succeed in Grabbing an Edge, you do not take any falling damage as you re-enter the water but are submerged to a distance that equals the height of your Leap.

Critical Success You Leap up to 15 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Success You Leap up to 10 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Failure You Leap up to 5 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Critical Failure You're until the start of your next turn.

name: Shroud of the Seas
desc: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above. When you're fully underwater, you'
fulldesc: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above. When you're fully underwater, you're to all opponents who are out of the water, and to those who are out of the water and more than 10 feet away from you.

name: Sailfish Strike
desc: Trigger You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.
fulldesc:
Trigger You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.

You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack. At the top of your Propelled Leap, you can make a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction instead of choosing to Grab an Edge. Your Strike gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. After your attack, hit or miss, you fall back into the water.

name: Tidal Wave
desc: Like the ocean in a storm, you overwhelm your opponents with speed and force. Move up to your Speed and make two Strikes. These Strikes can happen at
fulldesc: Like the ocean in a storm, you overwhelm your opponents with speed and force. Move up to your Speed and make two Strikes. These Strikes can happen at any point during your movement. If either Strike reduces a target to 0 Hit Points, you gain the condition for 1 round. You can only use the extra action to Stride or Swim.

name: Undersea Privateer Dedication
desc: Your training has taught you the basics of underwater combat. You become an expert in Athletics and gain the skill feat. If you're at least an expert
fulldesc:
Your training has taught you the basics of underwater combat. You become an expert in Athletics and gain the skill feat. If you're at least an expert in the weapon you're using when fighting in or underwater, you get the critical specialization effect of that weapon when you get a critical hit with it.

Undersea Privateer

name: Anchor Stance
desc: Requirements You're in or under water.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're in or under water.

You tense your muscles to make yourself neutrally buoyant and more difficult to move. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to or you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move. If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, attempt a . On a success, you move only 5 feet. Additionally, you don't have to take a Swim action each turn to avoid sinking or moving with the current.

name: Fast Swimmer
prereq: Undersea Privateer Dedication; you have a swim Speed
desc: You move more quickly underwater. Your swim Speed increases by 5 feet.
fulldesc: You move more quickly underwater. Your swim Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Trained Swimmer
desc: Thanks to tireless practice, water has become a natural environment for you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Sp
fulldesc: Thanks to tireless practice, water has become a natural environment for you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Speed, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain.

name: Float Free
desc: Frequency once per round
fulldesc:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You're underwater.

You move 5 feet or up to half your swim Speed vertically through the water. This movement doesn't trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.

name: Slippery As An Eel
prereq: Undersea Privateer Dedication; trained in Acrobatics
desc: You mimic the serpentine movements of an eel. While underwater, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act escape skill=acrobatic
fulldesc: You mimic the serpentine movements of an eel. While underwater, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act escape skill=acrobatics]], [[/act squeeze]], and [[/act tumble-through]].

name: Stealthy As An Octopus
prereq: Undersea Privateer Dedication; expert in Stealth
desc: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself. As long as you're separated from a creature by 20 or more feet of water, the turb
fulldesc: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself. As long as you're separated from a creature by 20 or more feet of water, the turbulence of the water grants you enough cover to attempt to [[/act hide]] from that creature.

name: Boarding Party
desc: You're practiced at scaling ships, and even a wet and slippery exterior won't stand in your way. You can a sea vehicle even if you have one hand occup
fulldesc: You're practiced at scaling ships, and even a wet and slippery exterior won't stand in your way. You can a sea vehicle even if you have one hand occupied. If both your hands are free, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check. You aren't while Balancing or Climbing on any part of a sea vehicle.

name: Riptide (Undersea Privateer)
desc: Requirements You're in Anchor Stance, and your target is within 5 feet of the edge of a water vehicle or already in the water.
fulldesc:
Requirements You're in Anchor Stance, and your target is within 5 feet of the edge of a water vehicle or already in the water.

You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer. Attempt an check against the Fortitude DC of a creature within 20 feet. If the creature is willing, you increase your degree of success by one (turning a failure into a success and a success into a critical success).

Critical Success The target is pulled 10 feet toward you.

Success The target is pulled 5 feet toward you.

Critical Failure Your movements cause you to be until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Interstitial Escape
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would be hit by a melee or ranged Strike, and you are not .

To evade your foe, you shift yourself to another location, teleporting from your current square to another unoccupied square within 30 feet. Additionally, you gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to 5 + your level.

name: Translocational Adept
desc: Your command over teleportation grows. You can cast translocate as an innate 4th-rank occult spell once per day. At 14th level, the spell is heightene
fulldesc: Your command over teleportation grows. You can cast translocate as an innate 4th-rank occult spell once per day. At 14th level, the spell is heightened to 5th rank. When you cast translocate this way, you can Part the Veil as a free action when you arrive at your destination, even if you wouldn't normally meet its requirements.

name: Aerial Flash
desc: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you. You teleport to any square within 60 feet that's within reach of a creature, then make a melee St
fulldesc: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you. You teleport to any square within 60 feet that's within reach of a creature, then make a melee Strike against that creature. After this Strike, you teleport back to your prior position.

name: Afterimage
desc: Trigger You use an action or cast a spell with the teleportation trait.
fulldesc:
Trigger You use an action or cast a spell with the teleportation trait.

You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square. This afterimage looks like you and can perform simple behaviors to make the deception more plausible but otherwise cannot move or take actions. A creature can distinguish between you and your afterimage easily. Your afterimage automatically fails all checks and DCs and is destroyed if it would take any damage; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute. Whenever you take the Step action, you can instead teleport to an afterimage instead. If you do, the action gains the teleportation trait, and the afterimage you teleport to is destroyed.

name: Hush
desc: Requirements You are veiled.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are veiled.

You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help. You teleport to a square within 60 feet and make a Strike against a creature; if you hit, it must attempt a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is then immune to your Hush for 24 hours.

Success The target is otherwise unaffected.

Failure The target takes @Damage[10d6[force]] damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[15d6[untyped]] damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 minute.

name: Veil Dancer Dedication
desc: You're able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice. You gain the action.
fulldesc:
You're able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice. You gain the action.

Veil Dancer

name: Contingency Leap
desc: Trigger You fall, and there is an edge or handhold within 30 feet.
fulldesc:
Trigger You fall, and there is an edge or handhold within 30 feet.

When imperiled by a fall, you swiftly transport yourself out of danger. You teleport to any edge or handhold in range, stopping your fall. If your destination is one you couldn't normally stand on (such as a handhold), you must succeed at your choice of an Acrobatics check or a Reflex save, usually at the Climb DC, as [[/act grab-an-edge]], but you take no damage unless you critically fail.

name: Dimensional Pilfer
prereq: Veil Dancer Dedication; expert in Thievery
desc: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners' noses. Attempt a Thievery check to Palm an Object or [[/act steal]] an ob
fulldesc: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners' noses. Attempt a Thievery check to Palm an Object or [[/act steal]] an object you can see within 60 feet. If you are veiled, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. If you succeed, the object vanishes from its current location and appears on your person.

name: Gossamer Blade
desc: Requirements Your previous action was a successful Strike against an creature. Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of y
fulldesc: Requirements Your previous action was a successful Strike against an creature. Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of your weapon to resonate through its victim. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,force]] damage per damage dice of your weapon.

name: Fade Presence
desc: You weave magic around you to mask your presence from observers. Once per hour each, you can cast and as innate 2nd-rank occult spells. You can target
fulldesc: You weave magic around you to mask your presence from observers. Once per hour each, you can cast and as innate 2nd-rank occult spells. You can target only yourself with these spells.

name: Warp Path
desc: Requirements You are veiled.
fulldesc:
Requirements You are veiled.

You fold space around you, transporting yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. When you arrive, make a melee Strike against one creature within your weapon's reach. On a critical success, you remain veiled until the end of your next turn or until you take another hostile action.

name: Dart Between
desc: Frequency once per 10 minutes
fulldesc:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

In the blink of an eye, you transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—you cannot Dart Between. When you arrive at your destination, you can Part the Veil as a free action, even if you wouldn't normally meet its requirements. If you are hidden, this action does not cause you to become observed provided you still have cover, greater cover, or concealment from the creatures you were hidden from after the teleportation.

name: Veil of Eternity
desc: You can remain within the interstices of reality longer. Your Part the Veil has a duration of one hour, though it still ends if you take a hostile act
fulldesc: You can remain within the interstices of reality longer. Your Part the Veil has a duration of one hour, though it still ends if you take a hostile action. Additionally, while Avoiding Notice during exploration, you can also Part the Veil.

name: A Hush Falls Over the World
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn. Creatures in your waking world become hidden to imprecise hearing or to precise hearing. A creature in your waking world attempting to use spell or effect with the auditory or sonic trait must succeed at a ; on a failure, the spell or effect is disrupted. Anytime a creature in the area is affected by an auditory or sonic effect, they must attempt a . On a success, they are not affected by the auditory or sonic effect, though they still may be affected by other aspects of an ability (for example, a creature hit by a weapon with a thundering rune would not take sonic damage but would still take the normal damage from the weapon).

name: Come In From the Wilderness
desc: Frequency once per hour
fulldesc:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your waking world is active.

A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth. For each source of persistent damage it is taking, the creature can immediately attempt a flat check to recover, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance. While swallowed, the creature becomes and cannot be targeted or affected by any new effects (ongoing effects, such as afflictions or persistent damage, continue to affect it as normal). At the start of your next turn, the creature regains @Damage[6d8[healing]] Hit Points and emerges in its previous location. If another creature is in that location, it is pushed to the nearest available space. The target creature then becomes temporarily immune to this ability until your next daily preparations.

name: The World Devours
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20], the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] or larger. If you use this ability while your waking world already has a creature or devoured, that creature is automatically freed. If your waking world ends, any creature affected by this ability is automatically freed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and Slowed 1, and takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect. A creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC; in addition to the normal checks to Escape, it can attempt a Nature check. If it Escapes, it is returned to the area where it was when grabbed. A creature with a burrow Speed can Escape automatically and move up to its burrow Speed as part of that action.

name: Awake With a Roar
desc: Trigger You Rouse the World.
fulldesc:
Trigger You Rouse the World.

When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting. All enemies in the area must attempt a save against your world rouser DC. A creature that attempts this save or observes this ability becomes temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2 and Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 3 and stunned 1.

name: World Rouser Dedication
desc: You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge. You gain the ac
fulldesc:
You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge. You gain the action.

As your ability to converse with the world grows, you can call on it to help you in other ways, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your world rouser DC.

World Rouser

name: Nature's Embrace
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

You call on the world to hamper your foes. Plants grab at them, wind or water currents buffet them, the footing shifts under their feet. Your waking world becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until the start of your next turn.

name: The World Whispers
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Your waking world tells you about the unseen creatures it holds. You [[/act seek]] in your waking world. If you succeed or critically succeed against a creature that was undetected by you, you Point Out the creature to any allies in your waking world. When you Point Out the creatures in this way, the action does not have the visual or manipulate traits, but still requires your allies to be able to hear and understand you.

name: All Returns To Slumber
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Your waking world returns to slumber, and lays the peace of deep sleep on all within it. You Dismiss your waking world, and all creatures in the area must attempt a save against your world rouser DC. Animals, beasts, and plants native to this world treat the result of their save as one degree worse. Creatures in the area then become temporarily immune to this ability for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature can't use reactions for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also Slowed 1.

name: Sheltering Hand
desc: 1 or 2
fulldesc:
1 or 2

Requirements Your waking world is active.

Animals, plants, and the earth itself rush to protect you from harm, interposing themselves between you and danger. You and your allies in your waking world gain cover from enemies you are aware of until the start of your next turn. The cover is based on the number of actions you spend. If you use one action, it is lesser cover; if you spend two actions, it is standard cover.

name: Dust Cloud
desc: Requirements Your waking world is active.
fulldesc:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight. All creatures within your waking world become , and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it until the start of your next turn. In addition, a creature that ends its turn in the area must attempt a saving throw against your world rouser DC as it inhales the particles. On a failure, it is until the end of its next turn or on a critical failure.

name: Wake and Tremble
desc: Trigger You Rouse the World.
fulldesc:
Trigger You Rouse the World.

You have the world wake with a great convulsion. All other creatures in the area when you Rouse the World must attempt a save against your world rouser DC.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls and lands .

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also becomes Sickened 1.
